# dsh-cli > An interactive terminal UI plugin for DeepSeek Harness. This is dkc's independently developed fork of [dsh-TUI by chimney](https://github.com/ccch1mneyyy/dsh-TUI). ## Preview
## Highlights - Streaming Markdown, tool cards, images, Mermaid diagrams, and keyboard completion. - A pixel whale, live work status, context bar, TPS gauge, and clickable timeline. - Session management with resume, fork, rewind, background work, and export. - DSH presets, skills, MCP, goals, subagents, provider authentication, and extensions. - Authentication for OpenAI, Claude, OpenCode, OpenRouter, Hermes Agent, and Infron. - Virtualized rendering and bounded caches for long sessions. - Optional scoped code analysis through the separate LSP provider; see [code-analysis setup and current acceptance limits](docs/code-intelligence.en.md). ## Quick Start Requires [Node.js](https://nodejs.org/en) `^22.19 || >=24`, pnpm 11, a [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) source checkout with dependencies installed, and `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY`. We aim to support current DSH APIs. Compatibility is checked against installed packages and the upstream default branch, without a release allowlist; see [ADAPTER.md](ADAPTER.md). Clone recursively to fetch submodules. In an existing checkout, run `git submodule update --init --recursive` before installation. ```sh git clone --recurse-submodules https://github.com/askdkc/dsh-cli.git cd dsh-cli pnpm install --frozen-lockfile pnpm build node scripts/with-publish-manifest.mjs npm pack --ignore-scripts TARBALL="$PWD/askdkc-dsh-cli-$(node -p "require('./package.json').version").tgz" cd ~/DIR/TO/deepseek-harness pnpm dsh plugin --profile dsh-cli add "@askdkc/dsh-cli@file:${TARBALL}" pnpm dsh --profile dsh-cli ``` Replace `~/DIR/TO/deepseek-harness` with your checkout path. The first interactive launch registers `dsh-cli`; open a new shell, then run it from your project directory. The managed command saves the built Harness checkout path, so a separate global DSH installation is unnecessary. Harness `plugin add` refreshes an existing managed command during updates; no manual registration is needed. An explicit `DSH_CLI_DSH_ROOT` overrides the saved path. To update this fork, rebuild and reinstall the tarball. `/update` uses the registry. Use the named `@askdkc/dsh-cli@file:...` form for local tarball updates. A bare tarball path can fail with `ENOENT` when pnpm resolves a previous `file:` dependency whose archive has been deleted. `TARBALL` holds the archive's absolute path; pass it to the install command instead of executing it. For PATH setup and install issues, see [Getting started](docs/getting-started.en.md). ## Use `Enter` sends, `Tab` completes, `Ctrl+Enter` interrupts and sends, and double `Esc` rewinds. Press `?` for shortcuts. The working-status line follows each accepted request in English, Japanese, or Chinese. Ambiguous short requests keep that session's previous progress language; `/lang` controls the rest of the interface separately. `/resume` opens the session manager; `/auth` connects providers and `/model` selects a model. `/bg` keeps a session running until the TUI exits. See [Interaction and commands](docs/interaction.en.md) for the full reference. `/model` opens a centered picker with Favorites, Recent, and provider sections. `/model seek deep` opens it with an order-independent search; an exact `/model provider/model-id` switches directly. In the picker, use `Ctrl+F` to toggle a favorite, `Ctrl+A` to connect a provider, and `Esc` to close. To import Claude Code, Codex, OMP, zcode, or Grok Build conversations, run `dsh-cli migrate` to see available histories, then `dsh-cli migrate [--dry-run]`. Tool traffic is not imported. See [Session migration](docs/migrate.en.md). ## Documentation - [Getting started](docs/getting-started.en.md) · [VS Code](docs/vscode.en.md) - [Interaction](docs/interaction.en.md) · [Configuration](docs/configuration.en.md) · [Themes](docs/themes.en.md) - [Architecture and limitations](docs/architecture.en.md) · [All docs](docs/README.md) - [Plugin development](docs/plugins.en.md) · [Contributing](docs/contributing.en.md) ## Acknowledgments The pixel whale's 22 hand-drawn frames and idle animations come from [dsh-ui-whale](https://github.com/lhh010/dsh-ui-whale) by [@lhh010](https://github.com/lhh010) (BSD-3-Clause). Thank you for the art and inspiration 🐋💜 Community projects and companion tools: [Friends' links](docs/links.md). ## License [MIT](LICENSE). The original copyright notice for chimney is retained; dkc's copyright notice covers the fork's independent development.

# dsh-working-activity input-language fork This local fork starts from `dsh-working-activity` 0.5.0 (BSD-3-Clause). It adds Japanese progress copy and a per-session `lang: input` mode. The original `auto`, `zh`, and `en` modes retain their behavior. The dsh-cli workspace links this package locally; its source manifest names `@askdkc/dsh-working-activity@0.5.0-input.0` through an npm alias. Build with `npm run build:working-activity` from the dsh-cli root. The publish-manifest helper bundles the compiled fork under the runtime dependency name, so an external dsh-cli installation does not need a separate fork release. `client-snapshot/` is the unchanged 0.5.0 Web client bundle and declarations. The build copies it into `lib/` after compiling the server side, so a fresh checkout still has the existing optional Web entry. This change targets the TUI; Web client language-aware ticking is not expanded here.

evidence.readmeExcerpt:
# dsh-tool-unoutloud

A DeepSeek Harness plugin that rescues the "tool call spoken out loud" failure:
the model writes its tool call (or raw XML) as **plain assistant chat text**
instead of making a real tool call. No tool call ⇒ the harness treats the
message as the final response and closes the turn — the chat stalls, and the
intended tool never runs.

When that happens at the end of a turn, `unoutloud`:

1. **detects** the stray call / raw XML in the closing assistant message,
2. **steers** a short (~60 token) nudge back to the agent — *"was that a
   mistake?"* — which keeps the turn open so the agent can react,
3. when the stray call is **parseable and its tool is registered**, registers a
   low-token `retry_stray_call` tool so the agent can execute the already-parsed
   call as a real tool call without retyping it,
4. when it is **not** parseable (or the tool is unknown), the nudge says so
   explicitly — *"do NOT call retry_stray_call"* — so the agent never attempts
   a retry that cannot work, and instead redoes the call itself.

## How it works

Everything runs inside `agent/turn-stopping` (serial, awaited before the turn
boundary commits):

- The final `assistant/message` of the closing turn is read from the session
  log (`session.snapshotEvents()`).
- The pure detector (`src/detect.ts`) returns one of four verdicts:

  | verdict     | meaning                                                          | action |
  |-------------|------------------------------------------------------------------|--------|
  | `none`      | normal reply                                                     | nothing |
  | `retryable` | parses, fixes, and the tool is registered                        | nudge + register `retry_stray_call` |
  | `shaped`    | looks like a call but can't be retried (bad JSON, no name, tool not registered…) | nudge **with the reason** and an explicit "do not call the retry tool" |
  | `xml-only`  | reply is raw markup with no readable prose                       | nudge, no retry tool |

- `src/prompts.ts` renders the verdict-specific nudge; it is steered as a
  plugin-sourced message via `agent.steer(...)`, which keeps the turn open.

### Parsing / "fixable" handling

Recognized stray shapes: `<invoke name="…">` (+ `<parameter>` entries,
`arguments="…"` attributes, JSON bodies), `<function_calls>` / `<tool_use>` /
`<tool_calls>` wrappers, and JSON call objects
(`{"name": …, "arguments": …}`, Claude-style `{"type":"tool_use", …,"input":…}`).
Fix-ups: XML-entity decoding (`<`…), markdown-fence stripping, trailing
commas, single-quote JSON, JSON-in-string arguments, unterminated (cut-off)
calls, and numeric/boolean/JSON parameter values.

### Safety rails

- **loop-bounded nudging**: a repeat of the *identical* stall text is never
  re-nudged in the same turn; a **different** new stall inside a steered-open
  turn does nudge again (a steer keeps the same turn number across many steps),
  bounded by the per-session cap (default 10) and cooldown (default 15 s),
- `interrupted` assistant messages are never judged,
- replies containing real `tool-call` blocks are left alone (that turn ended by
  tool design, not by a text-only stall),
- examples are protected: calls buried in prose or inside markdown fences are
  skipped, and `exampleSkipRegex` is tested against the **first and last 300
  chars** of the last *direct user* prompt ("show me an example…") — so a
  multi-KB paste that merely *quotes* "for example" mid-text cannot disable
  detection for the turn,
- the retry tool is registered **lazily** and unregistered when nothing is
  pending (its schema would otherwise cost tokens on every request),
- pending calls expire (`retryTtlMs`, default 5 min) and are single-shot on
  success, capped at `maxRetryAttempts` (default 3),
- **duplicate-call collapse**: if the stray reply repeats the *same* call two
  or more times (e.g. a retry after a "[Tool calls marked as invalid or timed
  out]" marker re-emits the call verbatim), the detector counts the identical
  copies (`identicalCopies`, compared on a canonicalized key so re-ordered
  `<parameter>`s still match) and the retry dispatches **exactly one** copy —
  both the nudge and the tool result say so, so the agent knows it was deduped;
  this is scoped to identical calls inside one reply, not cross-turn in-flight
  tracking,
- every listener is wrapped in try/catch — the plugin can never throw into the
  agent loop, and the detector is written to degrade to `none` on any internal
  error,
- the re-dispatch goes through the **full tool pipeline** (permissions, policy)
  as a nested call (`parent: exec.token`), and nested results
  (`additionalContexts`, `concludesTurn`) are ferried back to the retry tool's
  own result.

## Install

> **Why there are two routes:** Node refuses to type-strip `.ts` under
> `node_modules` (`ERR_UNSUPPORTED_NODE_MODULES_TYPE_STRIPPING`), so a *package*
> install must load the built `dist/index.js`. The *scratch* route mounts
> `src/index.ts` by absolute path (outside `node_modules`) and needs no build.

### Option A — scratch mount (recommended for development)

Append one row to your **profile's** `cordis.patch.yml`
(`%DSH_HOME%\profiles\web\cordis.patch.yml`):

```yaml
  - insert:
      - id: unoutloud
        name: 'F:/Fun/Tools/DeepSeekHarness/dsh-tool-unoutloud/src/index.ts'
```

Profile patches hot-reload on save — edit `src/*.ts`, save, and the plugin
reloads. Config via a `config:` field on the same row (see below).

### Option B — link install (package route)

```sh
npm run build            # emits dist/*.js (Node built-in type stripping, no deps)
dsh plugin --profile web add link:F:/Fun/Tools/DeepSeekHarness/dsh-tool-unoutloud
```

and mount it by package name:

```yaml
  - insert:
      - id: unoutloud
        name: 'dsh-tool-unoutloud'
        config:
          enabled: true
```

`main`/`exports` point at `dist/index.js`. **Re-run `npm run build` after
editing `src/`** — link installs don't see source edits until rebuilt.

## Config

| knob | default | meaning |
|------|---------|---------|
| `enabled` | `true` | master switch (`false` mounts nothing) |
| `toolName` | `retry_stray_call` | retry tool's name |
| `patterns` | 6 built-ins | regex sources scanned for stray calls |
| `exampleSkipRegex` | built-in | user-prompt guard ("show me an example…") |
| `xmlDominance` | `0.6` | min tag-char ratio for the `xml-only` verdict |
| `dryRun` | `false` | log the verdict, never steer |
| `maxNudgesPerSession` | `10` | per-session nudge cap |
| `cooldownMs` | `15000` | minimum gap between nudges |
| `retryTtlMs` | `300000` | pending retry window |
| `maxRetryAttempts` | `3` | retry attempts before giving up |

## Verify

```sh
npm test        # build + 36 tests: detector fixtures, plugin wiring, dist load

# strict type-check (editor-facing):
pnpm dlx --package=typescript@5.9.2 tsc --noEmit --strict --skipLibCheck \
  --target es2022 --module esnext --moduleResolution bundler \
  --allowImportingTsExtensions --lib es2022,dom src/index.ts

dsh --profile web --dump-config | Select-String unoutloud   # mounted?
```

Then trigger a stall (or just inspect logs) — a rescue logs
`nudged turn N verdict=…`; `dryRun: true` logs verdicts without steering.

## Rollback

- Option A: delete the `insert` row from the profile's `cordis.patch.yml`.
- Option B: delete the row, then `dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-tool-unoutloud`.

## Files

```
src/detect.ts            pure verdict engine (zero imports; unit-tested)
src/prompts.ts           three nudge templates
src/index.ts             plugin: config schema, turn-stopping hook, lazy retry tool
scripts/build.mjs        src/ → dist/ via node:module.stripTypeScriptTypes (no deps)
dist/*.js                built artifacts (what node_modules installs load)
test/detect.test.mjs     28 fixtures for the detector + nudge wording
test/integration.test.mjs  7 fixtures driving apply() against a fake context
                           (steer → guards → retry re-dispatch → teardown)
test/dist.test.mjs       1 fixture: the built artifact loads as plain JS
package.json             manifest (+ dsh.bundle.patch for the link/bundle route)
cordis.patch.yml         insert row for the link/bundle route
```

> `test/integration.test.mjs` imports the real plugin, which needs
> `@deepseek-ai/*` bare imports resolvable; the workspace `node_modules` is a

## Limitations

- Targets **native tool mode**; under PTC a root model-direct call would be
  denied (`UNKNOWN_TOOL`) — the nested re-dispatch mirrors `dsh-tool-retry`,
  which does run under the profile, but PTC is untested here.
- Only **turn-final** stray output is nudged (mid-turn stray XML is out of
  scope by design).
- One nudge per turn; a second mistake in the same turn is not re-nudged.
- The registered-tool check uses the global registry view; a tool registered
  only in another scope may downgrade `retryable` → `shaped` (safe direction).
- While a retry is pending, `retry_stray_call` is visible in all sessions
  (calls from other sessions fail with `NO_PENDING`).
- Complements `@canglongcl/dsh-tool-retry` (checkpoint/replay of *failed* tool
  calls) — different failure mode, no overlap.

# DSH MCP Server

[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-yellow.svg)](LICENSE)

A DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin that publishes a **Model Context Protocol (MCP)** server from the
running Harness host, so other agent harnesses — Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, another DSH, any MCP
client — can call DSH: start sessions, drive turns, wait for them, read transcripts, and cancel work.

The plugin is a Host-only bundle with **zero dependencies** (no DSH import, no third-party module),
so it installs into a profile and survives Harness upgrades that keep the service contracts.
Every request is attributed to the calling agent and every session is recorded against its creator,
so several harnesses can share one endpoint and still ask "which sessions are mine?".

```
other harness ──MCP (Streamable HTTP or stdio)──> DSH MCP Server ──> DSH services
                                                                     sessionController / sessionQuery / tools
```

## What it exposes

| MCP tool | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `dsh_run_prompt` | Start a **new** DSH session and run one prompt; returns the assistant's final text and the new `sessionId`. Supports `cwd`, `agentPreset`, `permissionPreset`, `model` (`provider/model`), `wait: false`, `timeoutMs`. |
| `dsh_continue_session` | Send a prompt to an **existing** session (resuming it if it is cold). Keeps the session's context and workspace; `permissionPreset` re-pins the session's sandbox mode and approval policy before the prompt, and `model` (`provider/model`) overrides the session's model. Without `model` the session keeps the model it already runs. |
| `dsh_list_commands` | The slash commands a session's agent can currently run: the global command layer plus whatever that agent's preset composes, so availability differs per agent preset. |
| `dsh_run_command` | Run one slash command in a session and return its settled `{ kind, text, commandId }`. `line` takes a complete command line (`"/compact"`, `"/permission danger-full-access"`); `command` (+ optional `args`) takes a bare name. The command executes immediately without a model turn. |
| `dsh_list_sessions` | Visible sessions with title, cwd, running state, archival state, last activity, and the recorded owning agent. `mine: true` (or the `restrictToOwner` setting) returns only the caller's own; `owner: "<id>"` returns one agent's. Archived sessions are hidden unless `includeArchived: true`, mirroring the Web UI. |
| `dsh_read_session` | Ordered `{ role, text, seq }` transcript of one session (user-authored and assistant messages only), plus the last durable `permissionPreset` when the session has one. Works while the session is archived and needs no running turn. |
| `dsh_wait_session` | Block until the turn a session is already running ends, then return the assistant text it produced — for `wait: false` starts, GUI-driven sessions, or another caller's work. Never prompts, steers, or cancels: reaching `timeoutMs` returns `status: "timedOut"` with the turn still running, so call it again; `status: "idle"` returns immediately when nothing is running. |
| `dsh_whoami` | How this endpoint identifies the calling agent — `x-dsh-mcp-client` header, else `initialize` `clientInfo`, else `User-Agent` — plus the sessions that agent created. Attribution, not authentication: callers share the endpoint token. |
| `dsh_cancel_session` | Cancel the active turn of a session without dropping its pending inbox. |
| `dsh_archive_session` | Archive one session durably: hidden from every grouping surface, and it cannot run a model step until restored. A session with running work is refused unless `stopActivity: true` (which archives first, then stops that work). Archiving drops the pin. |
| `dsh_unarchive_session` | Drop a session from the archive set; it is listed again and returns to its recorded workspace position. |
| `dsh_list_permission_presets` | The deployment's permission presets (each bundles a sandbox mode with an approval policy) plus the default for new sessions, for the `permissionPreset` argument above. |
| `dsh_list_tools` | The tools DSH exposes to its own agents, for choosing what a delegated prompt can do. |
| `dsh_status` | Endpoint, profile, version, session/live-agent counts, default model, active turns, and the default permission preset. |

Archival needs the Host's `workspaceRegistry` service (`@deepseek-ai/dsh-workspace`). Without it the
two archive tools report that the service is unavailable and listings simply omit the `archived`
field instead of guessing.

Permission presets need the Host's `permissionPresets` service
(`@deepseek-ai/dsh-permission-presets`). `permissionPreset` is applied through that service's own
`set()` — the same write path as the GUI `/permission` command — once the session is live and before
its prompt is admitted, so the turn's own tool calls already see the chosen sandbox mode and approval
policy. The outcome echoes the applied preset; `dsh_read_session` folds the session's last durable
`permission/preset` event back into its payload, and `dsh_status` carries `defaultPermissionPreset`
plus the catalog. Without the service the permission fields are omitted and
`dsh_list_permission_presets` reports that the service is unavailable. A session created without a
`permissionPreset` keeps the deployment default, exactly as a GUI-created session does.

Commands need the Host's `commands` service and are addressed by **agent**, not by session: the
registry merges a global layer with the layers of the preset that agent is mounted under, so
`dsh_list_commands` must be asked per session and a command such as `/compact` exists only when that
session's preset composes it (`standard`/`ptc`/`cordis` do; `minimal` does not). Execution goes
through the same `commands.execute()` the Web composer uses: the handler runs immediately, the
lifecycle is logged as `command/run` + `command/done`, and **no model turn is started**. `kind` is
`success` or `error`; a line the Host would not parse as a command, or a name it does not know, is
rejected with the available commands listed.

### Caller identity and session ownership

Every request is attributed to a calling agent and every session `dsh_run_prompt` creates is recorded
against that agent, so a shared endpoint can answer "which sessions did *this* agent start?":

| Rung | Signal | Example |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | `x-dsh-mcp-client` request header (or `--client` / `DSH_MCP_CLIENT` on the stdio bridge) | `codex` |
| 2 | the `clientInfo` block MCP clients send on `initialize`, cached per transport | `claude-code 2.0.1` |
| 3 | `User-Agent` | `cursor/1.2` |
| 4 | the auth peer (the bearer token, or DSH connection trust) | `token` |

`dsh_whoami` returns the resolved identity, its `source` rung, and the sessions that agent created;
`dsh_list_sessions` annotates each row with `owner` and `mine`, and accepts `mine: true`. The registry
lives in `$DSH_HOME/mcp/dsh-mcp-clients.json` (0600), so ownership survives a Harness restart.

This is **attribution, not authentication**: every caller presents the same endpoint token, and a
client may name itself anything with the header. Set `restrictToOwner: true` to turn the record into
isolation — a caller can then only list, read, wait on, continue, cancel, archive, or run commands in
the sessions it created (or adopted: a session with no recorded owner, such as one the GUI started,
is adopted by the first caller that drives it). A session owned by someone else is refused with a
diagnostic naming the owner.

Resources: `dsh://status`, `dsh://sessions`, and the template `dsh://session/{sessionId}`.

### Waiting for a turn

`dsh_run_prompt` and `dsh_continue_session` wait for their own turn by default. When a call must not
block for the whole turn, start it with `wait: false` and follow it with `dsh_wait_session`:

| Result | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `status: "completed"` / `"error"` | The turn ended; `text` is what it produced and `turnEndReason` is the Host's reason. |
| `status: "timedOut"` | `timeoutMs` was reached and the turn is **still running** — call `dsh_wait_session` again. |
| `status: "idle"` | No turn was running, so the call returned immediately. |

No wait path cancels or steers the session: a reached ceiling and a disconnected caller both only stop
waiting. A client with its own call timeout can therefore set `timeoutMs` below it and re-wait instead
of polling `dsh_read_session` in a loop. Only `dsh_cancel_session` stops a turn.

## Endpoint and authentication

On activation the plugin registers `POST /mcp` on the Harness web server (default
`http://127.0.0.1:19387`) and writes connection details to:

```
$DSH_HOME/mcp/dsh-mcp-endpoint.json      # mode 0600
{ "url": "...", "token": "...", "stdioBridge": "...", "tools": [...] }
```

Every request must present the bearer token:

```
Authorization: Bearer <token>
```

The token is **generated per activation** unless you configure a fixed one. Set a fixed token
whenever another harness keeps a saved config, because a generated token changes on every Harness
restart. In the desktop profile the `dsh-mcp-server` row carries one:

```yaml
- id: dsh-mcp-server
  disabled: false
  config:
    token: "<fixed token>"     # mirrored in the endpoint file and in the selfcheck bundle
```

Requests that already pass DSH's own connection trust (`ctx.connection`) are also accepted, so local
tooling that holds the Harness token works too.

The endpoint file is owned by the activation that wrote it: on a config hot-reload the outgoing
instance removes it only when it is still the owner, so the replacement instance's file is never
deleted mid-reload.

## Configuration

The bundle row in `cordis.patch.yml` accepts (all optional):

| Field | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `path` | `/mcp` | Route path on the Harness web server. |
| `token` | generated | Fixed bearer token; set this so external configs stay stable across restarts. |
| `url` | `$DSH_WEB_URL` or `http://127.0.0.1:19387` | Advertised base URL written to the endpoint file. |
| `endpointFile` | `$DSH_HOME/mcp/dsh-mcp-endpoint.json` | Where connection details are published. |
| `writeEndpointFile` | `true` | Publish the endpoint file at all. |
| `allowConnectionAuth` | `true` | Also accept requests admitted by `ctx.connection`. |
| `defaultCwd` | Harness default | Working directory for sessions started without `cwd`. |
| `defaultModel` | Harness default model | `{ provider, model, reasoningEffort? }` for **newly started** sessions without an explicit `model`. A continued session keeps the model it already runs. |
| `turnTimeoutMs` | `1800000` | Default wait ceiling for a tool call that waits for a turn. Reaching it stops the wait, never the turn. |
| `maxConcurrentTurns` | `8` | Concurrent waited turns before new calls queue. `dsh_wait_session` starts no turn and takes no slot. |
| `restrictToOwner` | `false` | Confine each caller to the sessions it created or adopted: other sessions are refused by id, and `dsh_list_sessions` returns only its own. |
| `clientsFile` | `$DSH_HOME/mcp/dsh-mcp-clients.json` | Where the caller registry (agents seen + session owners) is kept, mode 0600. |
| `clientsFlushMs` | `5000` | How long registry writes are coalesced before they hit disk. |
| `maxBodyBytes` | `8388608` | Request body ceiling. |
| `instructions` | built-in text | Replaces the instructions handed to the calling model. |

Example row:

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: dsh-mcp-server
      name: '@local/dsh-mcp-server'
      config:
        token: !!js process.env.DSH_MCP_TOKEN
        defaultCwd: /Users/me/work
```

## Connecting another harness

### 1. Streamable HTTP (no extra process)

Point the client at the endpoint with the bearer token:

```jsonc
// Claude Code / Cursor style MCP config
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "dsh": {
      "type": "http",
      "url": "http://127.0.0.1:19387/mcp",
      "headers": { "Authorization": "Bearer <token from dsh-mcp-endpoint.json>" }
    }
  }
}
```

### 2. stdio (harnesses that only spawn a command)

`bin/dsh-mcp-stdio.mjs` is a dependency-free stdio↔HTTP bridge. It discovers the endpoint from
`$DSH_HOME/mcp/dsh-mcp-endpoint.json` (override with `--url`/`--token` or `DSH_MCP_URL`/`DSH_MCP_TOKEN`):

```jsonc
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "dsh": {
      "command": "node",
      "args": ["<path-to-dsh-mcp-server>/bin/dsh-mcp-stdio.mjs"]
    }
  }
}
```

It forwards JSON-RPC messages verbatim, cancels the upstream request when the client sends
`notifications/cancelled`, and keeps stdout clean (diagnostics go to stderr). It also names its
launcher to the endpoint through `x-dsh-mcp-client`, from `--client <label>`, else
`DSH_MCP_CLIENT`, else the parent process name, else `stdio-bridge` — set the variable in the other
harness' MCP server config when the parent is a bare runtime such as `node`.

Because GUI clients launch with a minimal `PATH`, point `command` at an absolute Node binary and rely
on the bridge's `~/.dsh` discovery (both verified with only `HOME` and `PATH` set):

| Client | Config file | Entry |
|---|---|---|
| Claude Code (user scope) | `~/.claude.json` | `mcpServers.dsh` |
| Claude Desktop | `~/Library/Application Support/Claude/claude_desktop_config.json` | `mcpServers.dsh` |
| ChatGPT desktop / Codex | `~/.codex/config.toml` | `[mcp_servers.dsh]` |

```toml
# Codex / ChatGPT desktop
[mcp_servers.dsh]
type = "stdio"
command = "/absolute/path/to/node"
args = ["<path-to-dsh-mcp-server>/bin/dsh-mcp-stdio.mjs"]
startup_timeout_sec = 60
```

Restart the client after editing its config. A cloud MCP client (for example a web connector) cannot
reach a loopback endpoint at all — that needs a tunnel and a deliberate networking change.

### 3. DSH as its own MCP client

DSH ships `@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client`; a row like this registers this server's tools inside DSH as
`mcp__dsh__dsh_run_prompt`, …:

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: mcp-dsh
      name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client'
      config:
        serverName: dsh
        transport: streamable-http
        url: http://127.0.0.1:19387/mcp
        headers:
          Authorization: !!js '`Bearer ${process.env.DSH_MCP_TOKEN}`'
```

## Install into a profile

```bash
git clone https://github.com/baitouwuya/dsh-mcp-server.git
# then, from the Harness UI / plugin_manager:
plugin_manager install_bundle --target /path/to/dsh-mcp-server
```

or, equivalently, `action: install_bundle` with the absolute package directory as `target`.

### Self-check bundle (optional)

`selfcheck/` is a second, tiny bundle (`@local/dsh-mcp-selfcheck`) that registers DSH's **own** MCP
client against this server, so the published endpoint is continuously exercised and its tools appear
inside DSH as `mcp__dsh__*`. It is pure verification — disable or skip it if you do not want a
self-loop in every session:

```bash
plugin_manager install_bundle --target /path/to/dsh-mcp-server/selfcheck
```

The committed `cordis.patch.yml` carries **no literal token** (this is a public repository): set
`DSH_MCP_TOKEN` in the Harness environment, or patch the `mcp-dsh-selfcheck` row from your own
private profile, with the token the server is configured with.

## Verification

```bash
node test/mcp-self-test.mjs            # 11 transport checks, no Harness needed
node test/plugin-integration-test.mjs  # 43 checks: apply(), endpoint file, tools, transcript filter,
                                       # waiting, caller identity + restrictToOwner, archival tools,
                                       # permission presets, commands, model pinning, hot-reload ownership
node test/stdio-bridge-test.mjs        # 4 checks, needs a RUNNING Harness (one real delegated turn)
node test/live-e2e-test.mjs            # 38 checks over HTTP: protocol, resources, all fourteen tools,
                                       # archive/unarchive, permission presets, commands, error paths,
                                       # 4 real turns (needs a Harness)
```

Live checks used during development also covered: a real MCP client exchange against the running
Harness, an end-to-end `dsh_run_prompt` → `dsh_continue_session` → `dsh_read_session` flow, permission
presets applied and re-pinned over MCP and folded back out of the transcript, a command executed
without adding a model message, waiting on a detached turn without cancelling it, caller identity
over the header and User-Agent rungs, detached start + cancel, and the stdio bridge.

## Notes and limitations

- **Code changes need a Harness restart.** Re-enabling a bundle reloads its row but reuses the
  already-imported module generation, so edited plugin code only takes effect after restarting DSH.
  Config changes reach the running instance immediately; changing a bundle's package path may report
  `restart-required`.
- **The bearer token is a local secret.** The desktop profile keeps it in
  `$DSH_HOME/profiles/desktop/cordis.patch.yml`, and `selfcheck/cordis.patch.yml` repeats it. Rotate by
  updating both places. It authorizes full DSH session control over loopback, so treat it accordingly.
- **Localhost only.** The endpoint rides the Harness web server, which binds loopback. Exposing it to
  another machine is a deliberate networking change, not a plugin setting.
- **Approval and user questions.** A turn started over MCP runs with the session's own approval and
  sandbox policy (`permissionPreset`, or the deployment default); if a delegated turn needs approval,
  the prompt appears in the Harness GUI like any other session. Switching a session's preset from the
  GUI (`/permission`) and over MCP write the same durable events, so the last writer wins per session.
- **Commands are immediate and per agent.** `dsh_run_command` runs on the addressed agent's command
  layer (global + that agent's preset), so a preset-scoped command such as `/compact` may be absent for
  another session. It is not queued behind a running turn and it can mutate session state
  (`/permission`), so it carries the same authority as typing the command in the GUI; `dsh_list_commands`
  first is the way to know what a session accepts.
- Sessions started over MCP are ordinary DSH sessions: they appear in the Harness session list and can
  be opened and continued in the GUI.

## License

[MIT](LICENSE)

two archive tools report that the service is unavailable and listings simply omit the `archived`
field instead of guessing.

Permission presets need the Host's `permissionPresets` service
(`@deepseek-ai/dsh-permission-presets`). `permissionPreset` is applied through that service's own
`set()` — the same write path as the GUI `/permission` command — once the session is live and before
its prompt is admitted, so the turn's own tool calls already see the chosen sandbox mode and approval
policy. The outcome echoes the applied preset; `dsh_read_session` folds the session's last durable
`permission/preset` event back into its payload, and `dsh_status` carries `defaultPermissionPreset`
plus the catalog. Without the service the permission fields are omitted and
`dsh_list_permission_presets` reports that the service is unavailable. A session created without a
`permissionPreset` keeps the deployment default, exactly as a GUI-created session does.

Commands need the Host's `commands` service and are addressed by **agent**, not by session: the
registry merges a global layer with the layers of the preset that agent is mounted under, so
`dsh_list_commands` must be asked per session and a command such as `/compact` exists only when that
session's preset composes it (`standard`/`ptc`/`cordis` do; `minimal` does not). Execution goes
through the same `commands.execute()` the Web composer uses: the handler runs immediately, the
lifecycle is logged as `command/run` + `command/done`, and **no model turn is started**. `kind` is
`success` or `error`; a line the Host would not parse as a command, or a name it does not know, is
rejected with the available commands listed.

### Caller identity and session ownership

Every request is attributed to a calling agent and every session `dsh_run_prompt` creates is recorded
against that agent, so a shared endpoint can answer "which sessions did *this* agent start?":

| Rung | Signal | Example |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | `x-dsh-mcp-client` request header (or `--client` / `DSH_MCP_CLIENT` on the stdio bridge) | `codex` |
| 2 | the `clientInfo` block MCP clients send on `initialize`, cached per transport | `claude-code 2.0.1` |
| 3 | `User-Agent` | `cursor/1.2` |
| 4 | the auth peer (the bearer token, or DSH connection trust) | `token` |

`dsh_whoami` returns the resolved identity, its `source` rung, and the sessions that agent created;
`dsh_list_sessions` annotates each row with `owner` and `mine`, and accepts `mine: true`. The registry
lives in `$DSH_HOME/mcp/dsh-mcp-clients.json` (0600), so ownership survives a Harness restart.

This is **attribution, not authentication**: every caller presents the same endpoint token, and a
client may name itself anything with the header. Set `restrictToOwner: true` to turn the record into
isolation — a caller can then only list, read, wait on, continue, cancel, archive, or run commands in
the sessions it created (or adopted: a session with no recorded owner, such as one the GUI started,
is adopted by the first caller that drives it). A session owned by someone else is refused with a
diagnostic naming the owner.

Resources: `dsh://status`, `dsh://sessions`, and the template `dsh://session/{sessionId}`.

### Waiting for a turn

`dsh_run_prompt` and `dsh_continue_session` wait for their own turn by default. When a call must not
block for the whole turn, start it with `wait: false` and follow it with `dsh_wait_session`:

| Result | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `status: "completed"` / `"error"` | The turn ended; `text` is what it produced and `turnEndReason` is the Host's reason. |
| `status: "timedOut"` | `timeoutMs` was reached and the turn is **still running** — call `dsh_wait_session` again. |
| `status: "idle"` | No turn was running, so the call returned immediately. |

No wait path cancels or steers the session: a reached ceiling and a disconnected caller both only stop
waiting. A client with its own call timeout can therefore set `timeoutMs` below it and re-wait instead
of polling `dsh_read_session` in a loop. Only `dsh_cancel_session` stops a turn.

## Endpoint and authentication

On activation the plugin registers `POST /mcp` on the Harness web server (default
`http://127.0.0.1:19387`) and writes connection details to:

```
$DSH_HOME/mcp/dsh-mcp-endpoint.json      # mode 0600
{ "url": "...", "token": "...", "stdioBridge": "...", "tools": [...] }
```

Every request must present the bearer token:

```
Authorization: Bearer <token>
```

The token is **generated per activation** unless you configure a fixed one. Set a fixed token
whenever another harness keeps a saved config, because a generated token changes on every Harness
restart. In the desktop profile the `dsh-mcp-server` row carries one:

```yaml
- id: dsh-mcp-server
  disabled: false
  config:
    token: "<fixed token>"     # mirrored in the endpoint file and in the selfcheck bundle
```

Requests that already pass DSH's own connection trust (`ctx.connection`) are also accepted, so local
tooling that holds the Harness token works too.

The endpoint file is owned by the activation that wrote it: on a config hot-reload the outgoing
instance removes it only when it is still the owner, so the replacement instance's file is never
deleted mid-reload.

## Configuration

The bundle row in `cordis.patch.yml` accepts (all optional):

| Field | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `path` | `/mcp` | Route path on the Harness web server. |
| `token` | generated | Fixed bearer token; set this so external configs stay stable across restarts. |
| `url` | `$DSH_WEB_URL` or `http://127.0.0.1:19387` | Advertised base URL written to the endpoint file. |
| `endpointFile` | `$DSH_HOME/mcp/dsh-mcp-endpoint.json` | Where connection details are published. |
| `writeEndpointFile` | `true` | Publish the endpoint file at all. |
| `allowConnectionAuth` | `true` | Also accept requests admitted by `ctx.connection`. |
| `defaultCwd` | Harness default | Working directory for sessions started without `cwd`. |
| `defaultModel` | Harness default model | `{ provider, model, reasoningEffort? }` for **newly started** sessions without an explicit `model`. A continued session keeps the model it already runs. |
| `turnTimeoutMs` | `1800000` | Default wait ceiling for a tool call that waits for a turn. Reaching it stops the wait, never the turn. |
| `maxConcurrentTurns` | `8` | Concurrent waited turns before new calls queue. `dsh_wait_session` starts no turn and takes no slot. |
| `restrictToOwner` | `false` | Confine each caller to the sessions it created or adopted: other sessions are refused by id, and `dsh_list_sessions` returns only its own. |
| `clientsFile` | `$DSH_HOME/mcp/dsh-mcp-clients.json` | Where the caller registry (agents seen + session owners) is kept, mode 0600. |
| `clientsFlushMs` | `5000` | How long registry writes are coalesced before they hit disk. |
| `maxBodyBytes` | `8388608` | Request body ceiling. |
| `instructions` | built-in text | Replaces the instructions handed to the calling model. |

Example row:

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: dsh-mcp-server
      name: '@local/dsh-mcp-server'
      config:
        token: !!js process.env.DSH_MCP_TOKEN
        defaultCwd: /Users/me/work
```

## Connecting another harness

### 1. Streamable HTTP (no extra process)

Point the client at the endpoint with the bearer token:

```jsonc
// Claude Code / Cursor style MCP config
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "dsh": {
      "type": "http",
      "url": "http://127.0.0.1:19387/mcp",
      "headers": { "Authorization": "Bearer <token from dsh-mcp-endpoint.json>" }
    }
  }
}
```

### 2. stdio (harnesses that only spawn a command)

`bin/dsh-mcp-stdio.mjs` is a dependency-free stdio↔HTTP bridge. It discovers the endpoint from
`$DSH_HOME/mcp/dsh-mcp-endpoint.json` (override with `--url`/`--token` or `DSH_MCP_URL`/`DSH_MCP_TOKEN`):

```jsonc
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "dsh": {
      "command": "node",
      "args": ["<path-to-dsh-mcp-server>/bin/dsh-mcp-stdio.mjs"]
    }
  }
}
```

It forwards JSON-RPC messages verbatim, cancels the upstream request when the client sends
`notifications/cancelled`, and keeps stdout clean (diagnostics go to stderr). It also names its
launcher to the endpoint through `x-dsh-mcp-client`, from `--client <label>`, else
`DSH_MCP_CLIENT`, else the parent process name, else `stdio-bridge` — set the variable in the other
harness' MCP server config when the parent is a bare runtime such as `node`.

Because GUI clients launch with a minimal `PATH`, point `command` at an absolute Node binary and rely
on the bridge's `~/.dsh` discovery (both verified with only `HOME` and `PATH` set):

| Client | Config file | Entry |
|---|---|---|
| Claude Code (user scope) | `~/.claude.json` | `mcpServers.dsh` |
| Claude Desktop | `~/Library/Application Support/Claude/claude_desktop_config.json` | `mcpServers.dsh` |
| ChatGPT desktop / Codex | `~/.codex/config.toml` | `[mcp_servers.dsh]` |

```toml
# Codex / ChatGPT desktop
[mcp_servers.dsh]
type = "stdio"
command = "/absolute/path/to/node"
args = ["<path-to-dsh-mcp-server>/bin/dsh-mcp-stdio.mjs"]
startup_timeout_sec = 60
```

Restart the client after editing its config. A cloud MCP client (for example a web connector) cannot
reach a loopback endpoint at all — that needs a tunnel and a deliberate networking change.

### 3. DSH as its own MCP client

DSH ships `@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client`; a row like this registers this server's tools inside DSH as
`mcp__dsh__dsh_run_prompt`, …:

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: mcp-dsh
      name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client'
      config:
        serverName: dsh
        transport: streamable-http
        url: http://127.0.0.1:19387/mcp
        headers:
          Authorization: !!js '`Bearer ${process.env.DSH_MCP_TOKEN}`'
```

## Install into a profile

```bash
git clone https://github.com/baitouwuya/dsh-mcp-server.git
# then, from the Harness UI / plugin_manager:
plugin_manager install_bundle --target /path/to/dsh-mcp-server
```

or, equivalently, `action: install_bundle` with the absolute package directory as `target`.

### Self-check bundle (optional)

`selfcheck/` is a second, tiny bundle (`@local/dsh-mcp-selfcheck`) that registers DSH's **own** MCP
client against this server, so the published endpoint is continuously exercised and its tools appear
inside DSH as `mcp__dsh__*`. It is pure verification — disable or skip it if you do not want a
self-loop in every session:

```bash
plugin_manager install_bundle --target /path/to/dsh-mcp-server/selfcheck
```

The committed `cordis.patch.yml` carries **no literal token** (this is a public repository): set
`DSH_MCP_TOKEN` in the Harness environment, or patch the `mcp-dsh-selfcheck` row from your own
private profile, with the token the server is configured with.

## Verification

```bash
node test/mcp-self-test.mjs            # 11 transport checks, no Harness needed
node test/plugin-integration-test.mjs  # 43 checks: apply(), endpoint file, tools, transcript filter,
                                       # waiting, caller identity + restrictToOwner, archival tools,
                                       # permission presets, commands, model pinning, hot-reload ownership
node test/stdio-bridge-test.mjs        # 4 checks, needs a RUNNING Harness (one real delegated turn)
node test/live-e2e-test.mjs            # 38 checks over HTTP: protocol, resources, all fourteen tools,
                                       # archive/unarchive, permission presets, commands, error paths,
                                       # 4 real turns (needs a Harness)
```

Live checks used during development also covered: a real MCP client exchange against the running
Harness, an end-to-end `dsh_run_prompt` → `dsh_continue_session` → `dsh_read_session` flow, permission
presets applied and re-pinned over MCP and folded back out of the transcript, a command executed
without adding a model message, waiting on a detached turn without cancelling it, caller identity
over the header and User-Agent rungs, detached start + cancel, and the stdio bridge.

## Notes and limitations

- **Code changes need a Harness restart.** Re-enabling a bundle reloads its row but reuses the
  already-imported module generation, so edited plugin code only takes effect after restarting DSH.
  Config changes reach the running instance immediately; changing a bundle's package path may report
  `restart-required`.
- **The bearer token is a local secret.** The desktop profile keeps it in
  `$DSH_HOME/profiles/desktop/cordis.patch.yml`, and `selfcheck/cordis.patch.yml` repeats it. Rotate by
  updating both places. It authorizes full DSH session control over loopback, so treat it accordingly.
- **Localhost only.** The endpoint rides the Harness web server, which binds loopback. Exposing it to
  another machine is a deliberate networking change, not a plugin setting.
- **Approval and user questions.** A turn started over MCP runs with the session's own approval and
  sandbox policy (`permissionPreset`, or the deployment default); if a delegated turn needs approval,
  the prompt appears in the Harness GUI like any other session. Switching a session's preset from the
  GUI (`/permission`) and over MCP write the same durable events, so the last writer wins per session.
- **Commands are immediate and per agent.** `dsh_run_command` runs on the addressed agent's command
  layer (global + that agent's preset), so a preset-scoped command such as `/compact` may be absent for
  another session. It is not queued behind a running turn and it can mutate session state
  (`/permission`), so it carries the same authority as typing the command in the GUI; `dsh_list_commands`
  first is the way to know what a session accepts.
- Sessions started over MCP are ordinary DSH sessions: they appear in the Harness session list and can
  be opened and continued in the GUI.

evidence.readmeExcerpt:
# dsh-task-notify

任务完成 / 失败 / 取消时，通过 `@xmanrui/dsh-im` 推通知，支持**多渠道、多账户**同时投递。

- **判定来源**：事件订阅 `session/event` 的 `turn/end`，零轮询，**覆盖全部工作区的全部会话**。
- **投递通道**：复用 dsh-im 已有的渠道与账户配置（`ctx.dshIm.send`），不新建任何通道。
- **多渠道**：一条通知扇出到 `targets` 列表里的每一个目标（渠道 + 账户 + 收件目标），某个目标失败不影响其它目标。
- **按通道 + 账户启停**：每个目标自带 `enabled`；`false` 只停用它，其它目标照发。状态路由顺手列出**哪些通道有账户**（`channels`）。
- **文案**：首行「状态 | task-notify | 会话标题」，正文逐行「字段: 值」；失败 / 取消补一行「原因: ...」。
- **未绑定 / 账户未连接**：跳过 + 记日志 + 计数，不报错打断监听。
- **去重**：会话级——同一 `sessionId` + 同一结束原因只推一次（整批算一次，不是每个目标一次）。
- **待答问题也提示**：会话调 `ask_user_question` 要你做选择时推一条 ❓ 通知（只旁听不抢答，回答权原样交回 Web / dsh-im），单独用 `notifyQuestions` 开关控制。
- **哪些工作区发**：`onlyWorkspaces`（或卡片上勾工作区）为空 = 全部工作区都发；非空则先按工作区拦一道，被拦下的算 `filteredWorkspace`，不算失败。卡片里的勾选列表**读宿主登记的全部工作区**（`~/.dsh/storages/workspace.json`），不是只列跑过的。
- **正文可裁剪**：`fields` 决定正文带「会话标题 / 工作区 / 原因 / 答复首句 / 会话 / 时间」哪几项，全关也仍有一条首行（谁、什么状态）。
- **顺带一句结论**：`fields.brief`（缺省开）把本轮最后一条回复的首句摘进正文「内容:」那行——插件在本地读会话事件流，**不调模型、不花 token**。
- **设置里可改**：插件自带设置卡片（设置 → 插件 → dsh-task-notify → 行配置），开关、状态过滤、正文包含哪些字段、通知哪些工作区、目标列表、工作区规则都能改，**落盘即生效，不用重启**。

## 通知长什么样

```
✅ 任务完成 | task-notify | 任务完成通知插件对接 dsh-im
工作区: ziyongchajian

❌ 任务失败 | task-notify | prompt-optimizer 我想改一下系统提示词
工作区: default-workspace
原因: OpenCode's free tier can only be used from within OpenCode.

⚠️ 任务已取消 | task-notify | 微信文案微调
工作区: ziyongchajian
原因: 用户主动终止
内容: 改完了，通知里的会话改成标题了。  # 开了 fields.brief（缺省开）才有：本轮最后一条回复的首句
会话: 微信文案微调                  # 开了 fields.sessionId 才有：会话标题，没标题才退回裸 id
时间: 2026-10-14T14:22:52.983Z      # 开了 fields.time 才有
```

首行第三段是**会话标题**——就是侧栏会话列表里那一行文字，**完整不截断**，用来认出「这次在干什么」。它读会话事件流里最后一条 `session/title`（宿主 `sessionTitle` 服务读的是同一份数据），所以**你手动重命名后的名字就是它**。

打开 `fields.sessionId` 时，正文那行「会话:」也给同一个标题，只有标题还没生成时才退回裸 session id（方便配 DSH 的 `/session` 命令）。

「内容:」那行是本轮**最后一条回复的首句**（`fields.brief`，缺省开）：插件直接读会话事件流里的 `assistant/message`，剥掉代码块与 markdown、切到第一个句末标点（`。！？；`）、超 80 字截断加 `…`。**纯本地摘取，不调模型、不花一个 token**。
本轮被打断（`interrupted`）时这行不写——宁可不给，也不拿中途某一步的解说冒充本轮结论。与 dsh-im 同源，所以侧栏 / 微信里显示什么，这里就写什么。

标题取不到时，首行退回工作区名（不拿 session id 凑数，那串 uuid 只会占地方看不懂）。

各渠道收到的文案完全一致（同一 format 下）。

| 结束原因（`turn/end` 的 `reason.kind`） | 首行前缀 | 追加的「原因:」行 | 设置项 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `completed` | ✅ 任务完成 | 无 | `statuses.completed` |
| `error` | ❌ 任务失败 | `error.message` / `error.code` | `statuses.error` |
| `aborted` | ⚠️ 任务已取消 | cause：用户主动终止 / 上级会话取消 / 插件中断 / 会话释放 / 未知 | `statuses.aborted` |
| `blocked` | ⛔ 任务被拦截 | 无 | `statuses.blocked` |
| `max-tokens` | ⚠️ 任务中断（超出最大长度） | 无 | `statuses."max-tokens"` |
| `interrupted` | ⚠️ 任务中断 | 无 | `statuses.interrupted` |
| `forked` | 🔀 任务已分叉 | 无 | `statuses.forked` |

### 会话要你做选择时（`ask_user_question`）

会话调 `ask_user_question` 抛出待答问题时，也推一条独立的通知，单独用 `notifyQuestions` 开关（默认开，不归 `statuses` 管）：

```
❓ 需要你选择 | task-notify | 微信文案微调
工作区: ziyongchajian
待选: 用哪个文案？
  - 简洁版
  - 详细版
  - 先不改文案
```

只旁听不抢答：监听的是 cordis waterfall `user-questions/request`，插件打完招呼立刻 `return next()`，把回答权原样交给 Web 界面 / dsh-im 的回答器，绝不自己写答案。

最多列 3 道题、每题前 6 个选项，整块超 300 字截断加 `…`——手机上刷一屏就够，别把微信刷爆。

## 配置

插件不调 `ctx.settings.register()`，直接导出 `Config`；配置写在 loader 条目 `task-notify` 的 `config.rules` 下（见 `cordis.patch.yml`），也可被设置卡片覆盖。

```yaml
config:
  rules:
    enabled: true          # 总开关
    format: plain          # plain | markdown，所有目标共用
    skipSubagents: true    # 只报顶层任务，subagent 的轮次结束不推
    notifyQuestions: true  # 会话要你做选择时（ask_user_question）也推一条

    # 每种结束原因一个开关，全开。关掉哪种就不再推哪种，
    # 被拦下的轮次计入 /_task-notify/status 的 filtered。
    statuses:
      completed: true       # ✅ 任务完成
      error: true           # ❌ 任务失败
      aborted: true         # ⚠️ 任务已取消
      blocked: true         # ⛔ 任务被拦截
      max-tokens: true      # ⚠️ 超出最大长度
      interrupted: true     # ⚠️ 任务中断
      forked: true          # 🔀 任务已分叉

    # 投递目标列表：一条通知扇出到全部项。三者都取自 dsh-im：
    #   channel  = 渠道名（weixin / telegram / slack / email / feishu / ...）
    #   botId    = dsh-im 里的「账户」，形如 wx_<24 hex>
    #   targetId = dsh-im 里的收件目标，形如 tgt_<16 hex>
    #   enabled  = 这一条开不开；false 只是停用，别的目标照发（缺省 true）
    # 任一项缺 botId / targetId 会被丢弃（等于该目标不投递）。
    targets:
      - channel: weixin
        botId: "wx_0123456789abcdef01234567"
        targetId: "tgt_1a2b3c4d5e6f7890"
        enabled: true
      - channel: telegram
        botId: "tg_0123456789abcdef01234567"
        targetId: "tgt_0f1e2d3c4b5a6978"
        enabled: false          # 配好了但先不发

    # 只给这些工作区发通知：完整 cwd 或工作区目录名。空数组（缺省）= 全部工作区都发。
    onlyWorkspaces:
      - ziyongchajian

    # 通知正文带哪些字段。标题/工作区/原因/答复首句缺省带，会话与时间缺省不带。
    fields:
      title: true          # 首行的会话标题（关掉则退回工作区名）
      workspace: true      # 正文「工作区: X」
      reason: true         # 失败/取消的「原因: X」
      brief: true          # 正文「内容: X」= 本轮最后一条回复的首句（本地摘取，0 token）
      sessionId: true      # 正文「会话: 会话标题」（没标题才退回 session-xxx）
      time: true           # 正文「时间: ISO」

    # 按工作区覆盖目标列表。键可以是完整 cwd，也可以只写工作区目录名。
    workspaces:
      ziyongchajian:
        - channel: weixin
          botId: "wx_0123456789abcdef01234567"
          targetId: "tgt_1a2b3c4d5e6f7890"
      "E:/文档/deepseek-harness/default-workspace":
        - channel: slack
          botId: "sl_0123456789abcdef01234567"
          targetId: "tgt_0f1e2d3c4b5a6978"
```

`targets` / `workspaces` 里每一项都能配不同渠道、不同账户，并各自用 `enabled` 单独开关。写多个微信账户就多写几项 `channel: weixin`，`botId` 各不相同——插件不做去重，全发。

想「换个渠道发」不用删配置：把旧目标 `enabled: false`，新目标 `enabled: true`，随时改回来。全关（或目标都被停用）= 该工作区视为未绑定，走「跳过 + 计数」那条路。

两个「先拦一道」的开关，顺序是：**工作区**（`onlyWorkspaces` 非空且不含当前工作区 → 直接 `return`，计数 `filteredWorkspace`）→ 状态开关（`statuses`，计数 `filtered`）→ 去重（计数 `deduped`）→ 找目标（找不到，计数 `skippedUnbound`）→ 真发（成功计 `notified`，失败计 `failed`）。`onlyWorkspaces` 的空缺省是「全部发」，所以只勾工作区不会把默认目标丢掉。

`fields` 只影响正文，不影响投递与去重：全关掉时正文只剩首行（`✅ | task-notify | 工作区名`），适合只想知道「哪台机器跑完了」。`fields.brief` 摘的是事件流里已有的文本，只往外发、不写回会话，所以不会在后续每轮里重复计费。`fields.sessionId` 打开时那行给的是会话标题（重命名后就是新名字），只有标题还没生成才退回裸 id。

### 在设置里改（推荐）

装好之后不用再碰 yml：**设置 → 插件 → 已安装 → dsh-task-notify → 行配置**，就是本插件自带的一张卡片（第三方插件的设置页是插件自己写进宿主 slot 的，宿主不代填表单）。

卡片上能改的东西与上面配置一一对应：

- 总开关「启用通知」、七种结束原因的勾选、「跳过子代理」、「会话要你选择时也提示」、消息格式；
- 「通知里包含」：正文带哪些字段（会话标题 / 工作区 / 原因 / 答复首句 / 会话 / 时间），逐项勾；
- 「通知哪些工作区」：把见过的工作区列出来勾（括号里是结束次数）。一个都不勾 = 全部工作区都发；
- 投递目标列表（增删改）：启用勾、通道下拉（括号里是该通道的账户数）、`botId`、`targetId`，「选收件人」按钮会列出该账户下 dsh-im 已有的收件目标让你点。
  - 这一行的 `botId` 是空的时候点它，卡片会直接告诉你缺什么（不会静默无反应）；
  - 刚点「+ 渠道 · …」加出来的那行 `targetId` 是空的，按钮点下去会立刻出现在列表里（v0.7.0 前这种半填的行会被吞掉，表现为「点了没反应」），再点「选收件人」填上就行；
  - 该账户在 dsh-im 里一条收件目标都没有时，按钮下面会给出「去 集成 → 该机器人 → 投递设置 → 从已聊过的会话选择」的下一步，而不是把下拉藏起来。
- 按工作区换收件目标（每行一条 `名称=channel|botId|targetId`，与「通知哪些工作区」是两件事：这里决定发给谁，那里决定发不发）；
- 「刷新」重新读配置、「发测试通知」真发一条（不受状态开关影响，用来验证通道与账户是不是通的）；
- 底部计数：已推送 / 未绑定跳过 / 状态过滤 / 工作区过滤 / 去重 / 失败。

卡片顶部如果写着「dsh-im 当前没有在线账户」，说明 `ctx.dshIm` 没就绪或还没配任何通道——通知会全部跳过，不会静默丢。

**改完立即生效，不用重启 DSH。** 与 yml 的关系：卡片写的是同一个命名空间 `task-notify` 的配置，两边是同一份数据；真要批量编辑或做版本管理时改 yml，然后重启（或在卡片上点「刷新」让它重新读）。

卡片背后是插件自己起的 HTTP 桥（`/api/dsh-task-notify-settings/*`），只接受回环请求；HTTP 直连主要用于脚本化改配置：

```bash
# 读当前配置 + 在线账户 + 计数
curl http://127.0.0.1:19387/api/dsh-task-notify-settings/describe

# 写：关掉「已分叉」这类噪音通知
curl -X POST http://127.0.0.1:19387/api/dsh-task-notify-settings/mutate \
  -H "content-type: application/json" \
  -d '{"ns":"task-notify","ops":[{"op":"set","path":["rules","statuses","forked"],"value":false}]}'

# 实发一条测试通知
curl -X POST http://127.0.0.1:19387/api/dsh-task-notify-settings/test -H "content-type: application/json" -d '{}'
```

应答一律 `{ok:true,value:...}` / `{ok:false,code,message}`；写操作只接受本插件自己的命名空间（否则 `settings-not-exposed`）。
### 渠道与账户从哪来

dsh-im **没有**对外暴露「工作区 → 账户」的查询接口（`bot-workspace-store.mjs` 不在包的 `exports` 里），所以关联关系由本插件配置显式声明。三段信息都在 dsh-im 侧维护：

- `channel`：`ctx.dshIm.listBots()` 返回的 `[{ botId, channel }]` 里的 `channel`。
- `botId`（账户）：同上返回的 `botId`，形如 `wx_` + 24 位十六进制。
- `targetId`（收件目标）：dsh-im 的目标列表里自建的收件目标，形如 `tgt_` + 16 位十六进制。

装好后先看状态路由里的 `channels`（哪些通道有账户、各有几个）和 `bots`（逐个账户），照着填最省事：

```bash
curl http://127.0.0.1:19387/_task-notify/status
```

### 工作区匹配顺序

1. `workspaces` 里键 === `session.header.cwd`（完整路径）
2. `workspaces` 里键 === cwd 的目录名（如 `ziyongchajian`）
3. `targets`（默认列表）

## 安装

前提：本机已装 `@xmanrui/dsh-im`（本插件 `inject: ["dshIm"]`，没有它会跳过并在日志里说明）。

1. 在 DSH profile 的 `package.json` 里加依赖与 bundle：

```jsonc
{
  "dsh": { "profile": { "bundles": ["...", "dsh-task-notify"] } },
  "dependencies": {
    "dsh-task-notify": "https://codeload.github.com/bansheng2000/dsh-task-notify/tar.gz/refs/tags/v0.8.0"
  }
}
```

> 规格选择（三条都实测过，本机 `pnpm v11.7.0`）：
>
> | 规格 | 场景 | 说明 |
> | --- | --- | --- |
> | `https://codeload.github.com/bansheng2000/dsh-task-notify/tar.gz/refs/tags/v0.8.0` | **异地机器推荐** | 纯 HTTPS 下载，不碰 git，不需要任何凭据 |
> | `github:bansheng2000/dsh-task-notify` | 追 `main` 最新提交 | pnpm 会走 `git ls-remote git+ssh://git@github.com/...`，没配 ssh key 的机器 exit 128。修法：`git config --global url."https://github.com/".insteadOf "git+ssh://git@github.com/"` |
> | `file:E:/文档/deepseek-harness/dsh-task-notify` | 本机开发 | 必须**绝对正斜杠**路径，相对路径报 `ERR_PNPM_LINKED_PKG_DIR_NOT_FOUND` |
>
> `#semver:` 前缀（`...#semver:^0.5.0`）只对 `github:` / `git+https:` 规格有意义，tarball URL 用版本号本身固定。

2. 在 profile 目录装依赖：

```powershell
cd C:\Users\12576\.dsh\profiles\desktop
pnpm install
```

> DSH 自带的 pnpm 在 `F:\Programs\DeepSeek Harness\resources\runtime\pnpm\bin\pnpm.mjs`，
> 需要 `$env:ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE = "1"` 才能直接跑
> （本机没装独立 node：`$env:ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE="1"; & "F:\Programs\DeepSeek Harness\DeepSeek Harness.exe" "<pnpm.mjs>" --dir "<profile>" install`）。
> pnpm 装进 profile 的是**真实拷贝**：改了 repo 文件必须重跑 install 才生效。

3. 重启 DSH。

> 装完确认一下：`node_modules/dsh-task-notify/` 下应有 `lib/index.js` 与 `cordis.patch.yml`。

bundle 自带的 `cordis.patch.yml` 用 `- insert:` 创建 loader 条目，**不要**手改成顶层扁平 `- id:`——扁平形态只会改已有条目，条目不存在时静默空操作，插件永不挂载。

## 更新

```powershell
cd C:\Users\12576\.dsh\profiles\desktop
# tarball 规格：先把依赖里的版本号改掉（v0.8.0 → 新版本），再
pnpm install
# 裸 github: 规格跟 main，无需改任何东西
pnpm update dsh-task-notify
```

然后重启 DSH——不重启内存里跑的还是旧代码。

## 验证

```powershell
# 1) 插件自检（不依赖 DSH 宿主）
cd E:\文档\deepseek-harness\dsh-task-notify
& "F:\Programs\DeepSeek Harness\DeepSeek Harness.exe" test\selftest.mjs   # 服务端，54 项
& "F:\Programs\DeepSeek Harness\DeepSeek Harness.exe" test\client.mjs     # 设置卡片（含工厂 return、按钮点击、桥失败三类回归）
# 期望：dsh-task-notify selftest: ok / dsh-task-notify client selftest: ok

# 2) 确认已挂载：apply() 跑了才会注册状态路由
curl http://127.0.0.1:19387/_task-notify/status

# 3) 设置桥在（卡片靠它；404 = 桥没注册 = 服务端插件没挂上）
curl http://127.0.0.1:19387/api/dsh-task-notify-settings/describe
```

状态路由返回生效配置、dsh-im 在线账户与计数：

```json
{
  "ok": true, "active": true, "format": "plain", "skipSubagents": true,
  "notifyQuestions": true,
  "statuses": { "completed": true, "error": true, "aborted": true, "blocked": true,
                "max-tokens": true, "interrupted": true, "forked": true },
  "targets": [{ "channel": "weixin", "botId": "wx_...", "targetId": "tgt_...", "enabled": true }],
  "workspaces": {},
  "onlyWorkspaces": ["ziyongchajian"],
  "fields": { "title": true, "workspace": true, "reason": true, "sessionId": false, "time": false },
  "observed": [{ "name": "ziyongchajian", "cwd": "E:/文档/deepseek-harness/ziyongchajian", "count": 7, "last": "session-..." }],
  "bots": [{ "botId": "wx_...", "channel": "weixin" }],
  "channels": [{ "channel": "weixin", "accounts": 1, "botIds": ["wx_..."] }],
  "dshImInstalled": true,
  "seen": 12, "notified": 6, "failed": 0, "skippedUnbound": 3, "deduped": 1, "filtered": 0, "filteredWorkspace": 0,
  "questions": 2,
  "last": { "sessionId": "...", "turn": 3, "reason": "completed", "at": "..." }
}
```

`notified` 按**目标条数**计数（两个渠道都成功 = 2），不是按通知条数。

## 常见问题排查

| 现象 | 原因 / 处理 |
| --- | --- |
| `/_task-notify/status` 返回 404 | `apply()` 没跑：包没进 profile、bundles 没加、或 patch 写成了顶层扁平 `- id:`。查 plugin manager 的 `list_plugins`，应有 `include:task-notify` + `fiberPhase: active`。 |
| 加载时报 `Cannot find package '@deepseek-ai/schemastery'` | `@deepseek-ai/schemastery` 同时写进 `dependencies` 和 `peerDependencies` 时，pnpm 按 peer 处理、**不会**装进依赖树。本机因别的插件把它提升到 profile 根而假绿，干净机器上必炸。宿主侧 bare import 只能写进 `dependencies`，`peerDependencies` 留给宿主运行时自己提供的东西。 |
| `skippedUnbound` 一直涨 | `targets` / `workspaces` 缺 botId 或 targetId（半截配置会被整项丢弃），或该 `botId` 不在 `bots` 里 / `channel` 对不上。对照状态路由的 `bots` 核对。 |
| `notified` 涨但某个渠道没收到 | 单个目标失败不会影响其它目标，但只会在日志里留一条 warn（`send not accepted: ...` / `send failed: ...`，带 `code`）。按 `targetId` 搜日志定位是哪个目标。 |
| 微信 notified 但没收到 | `{sent:true}` 只代表平台接口接受，不代表送达。微信主动投递还需要用户消息里携带过的 `context_token`；先给机器人发一条微信消息再触发。 |
| 某个通道 / 账户不想收了 | 把那条目标 `enabled: false`（不用删配置）；全停用等于该工作区未绑定，`skippedUnbound` 会涨、日志写 `no enabled target bound`。 |
| 会话要你选择时没收到通知 | `notifyQuestions` 被关了；subagent 默认也不推（`skipSubagents`）。看 `questions` 计数涨没涨——涨了说明事件到了，是没绑目标或账户不在线。 |
| 通知太吵 | `skipSubagents: true` 过滤 subagent；`statuses` 里关掉不关心的类型（如 `forked: false`、`blocked: false`）；同会话同原因本来就只推一次。fork / 多轮会推多条，确需收敛可把去重键加上 turn。 |
| `filtered` 涨但一条没收到 | `statuses` 把这种结束原因关了（`filtered` 数被开关拦下的轮次）。看 `statuses` 哪项是 `false`。 |
| 某个工作区没通知、别的有 | 检查 `workspaces` 的键：先按完整 `cwd` 匹配、再按目录名匹配，两者都没命中才回落默认 `targets`。 |
| 改了 repo 代码但行为没变 | pnpm 装进 profile 的是真实拷贝。重新跑上面的 install，或直接改 `node_modules\dsh-task-notify\lib\index.js`。 |
| 设置里找不到 dsh-task-notify 的配置行 | 卡片挂在「插件 → 已安装」的**行配置**上，不是独立的设置页（宿主 rc.1 后只保留 `plugins.row.config` 这一个 slot）。若整行没有入口，先确认插件已挂载（状态路由 200）。 |
| 卡片写着「桥未注册」 | 服务端没跑或版本对不上：`/api/dsh-task-notify-settings/describe` 是 404 就是桥没注册，先查 `/_task-notify/status` 是否 200。 |
| 点「选收件人」没反应（v0.6.1 修） | 两个原因：① 这一行的 `botId` 是空的（旧版直接 `return`，什么都不做）—— 点上面的「+ 渠道 · …」按钮会自动填上；② botId 填了但 dsh-im 侧一条收件目标都没有（新机器常见），要去 设置 → 集成 → 该机器人 → 投递设置 →「从已聊过的会话选择」先建一条。v0.6.1 起两种情况都会在卡片上说清原因。 |
| 点「+ 渠道 · …」加了收件目标、卡片里却不出现（v0.7.0 修） | 桥和 `/_task-notify/status` 原来拿**归一化后**的配置去 describe，而归一化会把 `targetId` 为空的半填行整项丢弃 —— 写盘成功、回读却是空列表，界面表现就是「点了没反应」。v0.7.0 起 describe 走 `storedRules()`（只补默认值、不丢行），归一化只留给投递路径；`/_task-notify/status` 的 `targets` 现在能看到那行空的 `targetId`。 |
| 通知里「会话」那行是 uuid、卡片「通知哪些工作区」只列出一个（v0.7.1 修） | 标题原来只问 `ctx.sessionTitle`（本插件没 inject 到那个服务，永远拿不到）——v0.7.1 起改读会话事件流里最后一条 `session/title`，你重命名后的标题也认；工作区勾选列表原来只列跑过任务的，现在读宿主登记表 `~/.dsh/storages/workspace.json`，把全部工作区都列出来（括号里是会话数）。 |
| 卡片上按钮毫无反应、没有红字 | v0.6.1 之前 `bridgePost` 的 fetch / JSON 解析异常会直接 reject，调用方没接住。旧版本请先看浏览器控制台；新版会把「连不上设置桥」「返回 HTTP 401 而不是 JSON」直接显示在卡片底部。 |
| DSH 启动即崩，报 `invalid plugin, expect function or object with an "apply" method, received undefined`（v0.5.0 修） | `lib/client.js` 的工厂**没有 `return module.exports`**。宿主 cordis 拿工厂返回值当插件对象，只往 `exports` 上挂而不 return，得到 undefined 就崩。宿主自己 grep 不到这个字符串（它在 `app.asar/app.asar` 内层），错误原文见 `%APPDATA%\@deepseek-ai\dsh-desktop\logs\crash-*-web-boot.log`。`test/client.mjs` 里已加断言兜这条：`factory()` 的返回值必须有 `apply`。 |

## 文件

```
lib/index.js       插件本体（Config / apply / 文案 / 去重 / 多渠道扇出 / 状态路由 / 桥接线）
lib/bridge.js      设置桥：describe / mutate / targets / test 四个只读回环路由
lib/client.js      设置卡片（window.__ModuleLoader__.load 形态，挂 plugins.row.config）
cordis.patch.yml   bundle patch（- insert: 创建 loader 条目 + 配置示例）
package.json       main=lib/index.js, exports./client=lib/client.js, dsh.bundle.patch / dsh.client
README.md          本文件
test/selftest.mjs  服务端自检（54 项断言）
test/client.mjs    设置卡片自检（假 window + 假 react，渲染成纯对象树断言；含按钮点击、字段/工作区勾选写回、桥失败的回归用例，11 组）
```

# dsh-oikonomia-eye

**The Eye of Oikonomia** 是一个 DSH（DeepSeek Harness）插件：在循环提出一步的那一刻，把该任务的**形状词表**召回的判据注入进来，并在轮次运行期间执行那些带有机器可检条件的判据。它用词表的触发词匹配"本步 claim 的输入批次 + 会话日志尾部"的文本，把每个触发形状的判据文本作为一条 user 角色块挂到 `agent/pre-step` 上。带 guard 的条目还在另外三个检查点行动：`tools/pre-execute` 在条件不成立时拒绝被覆盖的调用，`tools/post-execute` 在被计数的动作越过上限后软提醒一次，`agent/turn-stopping` 在提醒未被采纳时引导一步有上限的对账。匹配与执行全程在本进程内完成，只读本地词表、本地条目表与本地语料：**默认模式不发起模型请求，也不发起网络请求**。

计划书留白的一处读法已由作者于 2026-10-15 裁定：`requires` 条件在**整个会话**内求值，因此前一轮跑过的读操作仍然满足它（见[已知限制](#已知限制)）。

> **本仓库当前状态：源码、测试与构建产物已落地；插件已能对着已发布的 DSH 线编译、构建并跑测试。**
> `src/`（11 个文件，含未跟踪的 `exposure.ts`）、`tests/`（10 个 spec + `support/mock-adapter.ts`）、`eval/`、
> `examples/fixtures/oikonomia-eye/`（示例部署数据）与构建产物 `dsh/` 都已在位。
> **本轮（前移轮）实测**：`typecheck` **0 错**（此前 75）、`test` **75 过 / 2 挂**（此前 32 过 / 45 挂）、
> `lint` 与 `peers:assert` 通过、`build` **含声明**首次通过、`check-pack` 对真 tarball 全 PASS。
> 源码原本写在本仓旧基线 `0.1.1-rc.2` 上，本轮把四条 API 分歧前移到已发布线；**前移只在包内做，不改判据语义**。
> **declaration merging 对消费方可见已解决**：`tsup` 会丢掉两处 `declare module`，构建后由 `scripts/inject-augments.mjs`
> 把它们逐字节注入消费方必然加载的 `dsh/index.d.ts`（正例 + 负例双证见 [RISKS.md](RISKS.md) R8.5）。残留是 2 个失败用例（1 个是读数定义问题、1 个是上游 `agent-spine` 未发布到区间内），
> 见 [RISKS.md](RISKS.md) R10。四条分歧的发布线证据见[与 monorepo 源码面的一致性说明](#与-monorepo-源码面的一致性说明)。
> 依赖勘定见 [DEPENDENCIES.md](DEPENDENCIES.md)。

---

## 这是什么

- **形状词表模式（shape mode）**：词表是一组形状，每个形状有 `id` 与非空 `trigger` 列表。查询文本命中形状的至少一个**窄**触发词时，该形状**触发**；只被宽词命中的形状被抑制并如实上报，而不是注入。
- **判据库**：条目表是判据文本的真源。每条判据带自己的内容哈希 `sha256_16`，加载期校验：文本被改过而戳没重打，则**加载期抛错**，而不是悄悄改变判据的含义。
- **三个中轮检查点 + 一个作者命令**：拒绝（deny）、软提醒（reminder）、对账（reconcile），以及作者录入命令（默认 `/eye`）。
- **每轮留痕**：每轮写一条 `coordinate/round` 事件到会话日志，记录注入/命中/漏配/开销，以及（见下）曝光窗口与行为距离读法。

本包只实现形状词表模式：没有嵌入、没有分面位置、没有衰减调度，`axes: 'off'` 是轮次记录唯一可能的状态。

## 安装与挂载

本包以 **DSH bundle 层**的形式挂载。`package.json` 自己声明了这件事：

```json
"dsh": { "bundle": { "patch": "./cordis.patch.yml" } }
```

`cordis.patch.yml` 把插件插入 profile：

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: oikonomia-eye
      name: 'dsh-oikonomia-eye'
```

`exports` 暴露两个入口，插件本体是纯 JS（`dsh/index.js`），由包根导出：

| 入口 | 文件 |
|---|---|
| `.` | `./dsh/index.js` + 声明 `./dsh/index.d.ts` |
| `./invariant` | `./dsh/invariant.js` + 声明 `./dsh/invariant.d.ts` |
| `./src/*` | `./src/*`（源码平面，供本仓库自己的测试与工具解析） |
| `./package.json` | `./package.json` |

**没有 `./client` 入口。** 本包没有 UI 半边：早先的骨架里有一条指向 `dsh/client.js` 的 `exports["./client"]`，
但该文件从不产生，保留它只会让 `import 'dsh-oikonomia-eye/client'` 以难懂的方式失败，因此已删除。
同理，`files` 里也不再列 `dist/`：本包不发 CLI、不发 client，插件半边就是全部构建产物。

挂载步骤与已发布的既有插件仓库一致（本包与其同形）：

1. 让本包可被解析：把它作为依赖装进目标 DSH profile 的依赖面（本地开发时是 `link:`，发布后是版本号）。**注意 `auto-install-peers=false`**：peer 依赖不会自动装，DSH 运行时那一侧必须已经具备它们。
2. 把 `dsh-oikonomia-eye` 加进该 profile 的 bundle 列表，使 `cordis.patch.yml` 被应用。也可以按该 profile 的既有做法手动加一条 patch 行：`id: oikonomia-eye`、`name: 'dsh-oikonomia-eye'`。
3. 在组合文件里给这一行 `config`（三个路径必填，见下表）。
4. 重启 / 重载该 profile 并核对：插件加载期会**大声失败**——文件缺失、YAML 不可解析、条目引用未声明的形状、已声明形状没有条目、`sha256_16` 缺失或不符，一律在加载期抛错，而不是把闸门降级成宽松版。

> **【已实测】** 抽取步骤跑通了打包与消费者解析：`npm pack` 产出的 tarball 被 `check-pack` 装进一个临时消费者
> （`npm install --no-save --ignore-scripts <tgz>`），随后 `node` 按包名解析到 `exports["."]` 并成功 import，
> 导出为 `Config, apply, name`（8 项检查全 PASS，见 RISKS.md「已实测通过的部分」）。
> 仍未实测的是**装进一个真实 DSH profile 并重启**这一步：本轮没有可用 profile，也没有跑 `dsh` 本身。

### 部署输入（三个必填路径）

三个路径没有默认值：词表、条目表与语料都是部署输入，给默认值等于凭空发明一份。DSH 组合文件里的一个最小例子：

```yaml
- id: oikonomia-eye
  name: 'dsh-oikonomia-eye'
  config:
    lexiconPath: C:/path/to/shapes.yaml       # required
    entriesPath: C:/path/to/entries.yaml      # required
    corpusPath: C:/path/to/docs               # required
    corpusExtensions: [.md]                   # default
    wideRatio: 0.02                           # default
    minCjkTermLength: 2                       # default
    maxEntries: 3                             # default
    maxBlockChars: 1200                       # default
    queryChars: 4000                          # default
    denyMode: enforce                         # default; `off` registers no pre-execute listener
    maxDenialsPerTurn: 2                      # default
    maxReconcilesPerTurn: 1                   # default
    authorCommand: eye                        # default; command name without the slash
    exposureWindowRounds: 20                  # default; rounds one exposure window counts over
    residentEntriesLimit: 2                   # default; entries the always-present block may carry
    residentCharsLimit: 400                   # default; characters the always-present block may have
```

## 配置项

下表每个字段都标出本包在**哪里消费**它，因此"没有消费者的字段"一眼可见。三个路径没有默认值，其余为表中所述的默认值；`wideRatio` 必须落在 `(0, 1]`。

| 字段 | 含义 | 消费点 |
|---|---|---|
| `lexiconPath` | 形状词表文件：一个带 `shapes` 列表的映射，每个形状有 `id` 与非空 `trigger` 列表。 | `src/index.ts:160` |
| `entriesPath` | 判据条目表：一个带 `entries` 列表的映射，每条有 `id`、`shape`、`text`、`source`、以及该文本的 `sha256_16` 戳，可选 `resident: true` 与 `guard`。改动之后必须重打戳（见下节）。 | `src/index.ts:160` |
| `corpusPath` | 计算词频所用的语料文件或目录。 | `src/index.ts:162` |
| `corpusExtensions` | 目录扫描接受的扩展名（默认 `['.md']`）。 | `src/index.ts:162` |
| `wideRatio` | 触发词的文档频率达到语料该比例即判为宽词（默认 `0.02`，须在 `(0,1]`）。 | `src/index.ts:161`（闸门）与 `:243`（每轮留痕） |
| `minCjkTermLength` | 可保持窄词的最短 CJK 词长（默认 `2`）；更短的 CJK 词一律判宽。 | `src/index.ts:161` |
| `maxEntries` | 单个注入块最多携带的条目数（默认 `3`）。 | `src/index.ts:272` |
| `maxBlockChars` | 单块渲染文本的最大字符数（默认 `1200`）。 | `src/index.ts:272` |
| `queryChars` | 每轮匹配所用召回文本的最大字符数（默认 `4000`）。 | `src/index.ts:231` |
| `denyMode` | `enforce` 在 guard 条件不成立时拒绝被覆盖的调用；`off` 不注册 pre-execute 监听，guard 既不评估也不留痕。 | `src/index.ts:180`（注册）与 `:241`（每轮留痕） |
| `maxDenialsPerTurn` | 一轮允许收到的拒绝次数上限（默认 `2`）；超过后 guard 停止拦截并记 `capped`。 | `src/index.ts:180` |
| `maxReconcilesPerTurn` | 一轮在收束边界允许收到的对账步数上限（默认 `1`）。 | `src/index.ts:180` |
| `authorCommand` | 作者录入命令的名字，不带斜杠（默认 `eye`）。 | `src/index.ts:199` |
| `exposureWindowRounds` | 每轮曝光窗口计数的 pre-step 轮次数（默认 `20`）。 | `src/index.ts:149` 与 `:240` |
| `residentEntriesLimit` | 常驻块最多携带的条目数（默认 `2`）。 | `src/index.ts:173` 与 `:292` |
| `residentCharsLimit` | 常驻块的最大字符数（默认 `400`）。 | `src/index.ts:174` 与 `:292` |

> 表里的行号指**源码修订**（见文末"来源修订"）的 `src/index.ts`。抽取落地后源码行号会变，届时以实际文件为准。

所有路径与所有数值字段都在**插件加载期**校验：文件缺失、YAML 不可解析、条目引用未声明的形状、已声明形状没有条目（因此"命中却无物可注入"的轮次不可能出现）、`sha256_16` 缺失或与自身文本不符、guard 出现 schema 未记录的字段、计数阈值小于 2、deny 条件类型未实现、路径谓词没有声明读取路径的参数、上限小于 1、命令名不符合注册表文法，一律在加载期抛错。

## 判据库与生成器怎么用

判据库是**两份 YAML 加一份语料**：

- **形状词表**（`lexiconPath`）：形状 `id` 与触发词。规则与常量对齐参考闸门 `shape_gate.py`（`shape-gate/1`、宽词比例 `0.02`、单个 CJK 字符永不判窄），包括"宽词不能单独召回形状"这一条。
- **条目表**（`entriesPath`）：判据文本的真源。每条带 `sha256_16`——**文本的内容哈希**。
- **语料**（`corpusPath`）：宽词频率的分母。

### 打戳（`eval/stamp-entries.mjs`）

条目表的改动**必须**跟着重打戳：

```sh
# 写入戳（就地改写，行级；注释、键序与无关行都原样保留）
node eval/stamp-entries.mjs <entries.yaml> [more.yaml ...]

# 只报告，不写文件；有文件待打戳时退出码为 1
node eval/stamp-entries.mjs --check <entries.yaml> [...]
```

退出码：`0` = 全部已打戳（`--check` 时表示"本来就是最新的"），`1` = 有文件需要打戳（仅 `--check`），`2` = 用法或 I/O 错误。

戳的位置是**约定的一部分**：戳紧跟在该条目的 `source:` 行之后（没有 `source:` 则跟在 `text:` 之后）；脚本会把早先布局留下的游离戳**移到**该位置，而不是再写一个，所以跑两遍产生**逐字节相同**的文件。改判据文本、甚至只是挪动一个字段，都会让文件停在"戳不属于"的布局上——`--check` 会一直报该文件，直到把表写回上述布局。

### 判据的形状

条件无法用 `condition: {kind: requires}`（会话内列出的工具已经跑过）表达时，该判据**不能拒绝，只能提醒**——这是当前唯一机器可检的前提类型。范围匹配读取声明的 `fileArgument`：调用没带该参数、或该处不是字符串时不算被覆盖。

### 判别值 `oikonomia-eye` 故意保持不变

抽取时包名从 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-oikonomia-eye` 改成了 `dsh-oikonomia-eye`，JSDoc 的 `@module` 标签、
不变量断言的包名（`src/invariant.ts` 的 `PACKAGE_NAME`）与测试里的自引用都跟着改了。**唯独 `source.kind: 'oikonomia-eye'` 没有改，这是有意的**：
该判别值是**耐久数据的一部分**，已经写进会话日志的 `user/message` 事件里（它是 `src/types.ts` 往 `MessageSourceMap` 注册的键，也是不变量校验的入口）。
把它改成新包名会让已存在的日志记录变成未知来源，"谁在什么检查点注入了什么"这条审计链就断在这里。
同理，`cordis.patch.yml` 里的 row id 与 `name` 是**加载配置**，与日志里的判别值不是同一个命名空间，改包名不牵动它们。

## 与 monorepo 源码面的一致性说明

**本 kit 面向已发布的 DSH 线；monorepo 里的 `packages/experimental/oikonomia-eye` 面向工作区基线。
两者有意分歧，本文逐条列出分歧点。** 前移只发生在本 kit 内 —— 工作区那份源码一个字都没动。

前移的依据是**从 registry 下载的真 tarball**，按各包 `exports["."].types` 声明的入口读 `.d.ts` 原文；
不按名字猜，也不按"仓库里有"推断"发布线也有"。三条线都查了：`0.1.2-rc.1`（本包 peer 区间下界）、
`0.1.7-rc.2`（本包 devDependencies 钉住的那条）、`0.2.0-rc.2`（0.2 线）。

### 分歧一：读会话日志的方式

| | 工作区（REPO） | 已发布线（三条都有） |
|---|---|---|
| 入口 | `get events(): readonly SessionEvent[]`（`packages/core/session/src/index.ts:559`），**缓存**快照（`:550-562` 的 `this.eventsSnapshot ??= Object.freeze([...this.log])`） | `snapshotEvents(fromSeq?, toSeqExclusive?): readonly SessionEvent[]`（`dsh-session@0.1.7-rc.2` 的 `lib/types/index.d.ts:193`），**每次调用新建**快照 |
| 语义 | 同一 handler 内多次读返回同一数组 | 每次调用得到新的冻结数组 |
| 弃用 | 未弃用 | 三条线都标 `@deprecated Existing logic may remain unmigrated for now, but new calls are prohibited.` |

**本包怎么改的**：把每个 handler 里的多处 `session.events` 收敛为**一次**
`const events = session.snapshotEvents()` 再复用，以保住"同一 handler 内所有读取看到同一日志状态"这条
原有语义。**没有别的等价物可用**：`session.surface`（`SessionSurface`，`lib/types/surface.d.ts:118-125`）
只给 `nodes`（`SessionSeq` 序号数组）与两个 generation 计数，**不是日志**。

**Monorepo 侧要知道什么**：本包吃着一个弃用 API。发布线给"读日志快照"的唯一非弃用入口是
`session.surface`，而它不含事件；因此若上游希望插件不再用弃用面，需要先提供一个非弃用的日志读入口。

### 分歧二：工具调用 id 的品牌函数

| | 工作区（REPO） | 已发布线（三条都有） |
|---|---|---|
| 名字 | `CallId`（`packages/llm/llm/src/brand.ts:31`） | `ToolCallId`（`dsh-llm@0.1.7-rc.2` 的 `lib/types/brand.d.ts:31`） |
| 位置 | 包根（`src/index.ts:35` 的 `export * from './brand.ts'` 把它带到根） | 包根 `export *` 的仍是 `./brand.ts`，**但 brand 里那个名字是 `ToolCallId`** ⇒ 包根没有 `CallId` |
| 用到它的类型 | `ToolCallBlock.id: CallId`（`packages/llm/llm/src/types.ts:81`） | `ToolCallBlock.id: ToolCallId`（`lib/types/types.d.ts:85-86`） |

**本包怎么改的**：显式走子路径并改名 ——
`import { ToolCallId } from '@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm/brand'`。三条线的 `exports` 都有 `"./brand"`，
所以这是"发布线真实存在的 exports 表"下的最小修法，**不需要**在 `package.json` 里额外声明子路径依赖，
也**不需要** `tsconfig` 的 `paths` 映射。

**命中位置**：本包**源码对 `CallId` 零命中**；命中它的是两处测试支持 ——
`tests/support/mock-adapter.ts`（`:18` 导入、`:47` 调用）与
`examples/fixtures/oikonomia-eye/oikonomia-eye-fixture.ts`（`:10` 导入、`:46` 调用）。
后者原先让组合 spec 的夹具报 `failed to import`；改用 `ToolCallId` 后该夹具已可加载。

### 分歧三：消息来源的判别值

| | 工作区（REPO） | 已发布线 |
|---|---|---|
| `MessageSourceMap['plugin']` | 有（`{ kind: 'plugin'; plugin: string } & ContextFormed`） | **`0.1.7-rc.2` / `0.2.0-rc.2` 没有**；`0.1.2-rc.1` 有（`lib/types/message.d.ts:98-101`） |
| 上两条线实际有什么 | — | `user` / `model` / `tool` / `'system-prompt'`（`message.d.ts:101-108`） |
| 发布线的设计声明 | — | `Merge-extensible sum type — each producer declares its own kind in its own module; there is no shared catch-all plugin kind.`（`message.d.ts:92-94`） |

**本包怎么改的**：

1. **插件的来源判别值不变**：`source.kind = 'oikonomia-eye'`（声明在 `src/types.ts:63-67`）。
   这正是发布线要的"每个生产者声明自己的 kind"形态。
2. **那处临时消息自解**：`src/index.ts` 里给 token meter 计价的临时 `user` 消息原本构造
   `{ kind: 'plugin', plugin: name }`。已改成本包自己的 `kind: 'oikonomia-eye'`，并补齐
   `OikonomiaEyeSource` 的字段（`form`/`summary`/`checkpoint`/`lexicon`/`entries`/`textSha256_16` 等）。
   该消息**不进行耐久日志**，只被 meter 计价。
3. **一处真实的能力降级**：`foreignReminders()` 原本统计"别的插件塞进同一批次的提醒"，判据是
   `kind === 'plugin'`。这个共享 kind 在 `0.1.7-rc.2` / `0.2.0-rc.2` 上不存在，因此改为
   "kind 不属于 `user|model|tool|system-prompt` 者即外来"。这是**近似**：发布线上同批次里
   `kind: 'user'` 的消息不再计入。发布线没有给出"这条消息是哪个插件产的"的可判定入口。

### 分歧四：创建 agent 的调用形态

| | 工作区（REPO） | 已发布线（三条都有） |
|---|---|---|
| `agentLoop.create()` | `create(id, options = {}, meta = {}): Agent` —— **同步**（`packages/core/agent-loop/src/index.ts:589`） | `create(id, options?, meta?): Promise<Agent>`（`dsh-agent-loop@0.1.7-rc.2` 的 `lib/types/index.d.ts:135`） |

## 非预注册项与追认状态

本包中计划书**未预注册**的读数与待定读数。**引用其中任何一项都必须同时带上它的性质；一项都不得当作预注册判据使用。**

| 项 | 出处 | 性质 | 是否参与判定 | 追认状态 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 部署级曝光窗口（`exposureWindow`、`windowRounds`） | 本包对墙纸率分母的读法 | 自选读法，计划书未写 | 每轮留痕；无任何闸门判定依赖它 | **【待作者追认】—— 本包不主张任何墙纸率** |
| 条件作用域 = 整个会话 | 作者裁定，2026-10-15 | 已裁定 | 是，两条测试钉住 | 已追认 |
| `dropped` 元素形如 `<entryId>@<source>` | 计划书十三补 1.1 / 协调者裁定 | 耐久字段**形态变更** | 是，不变量校验形态 | 已追认；更早写下的记录不再通过 |
| 条目表内容哈希 `sha256_16` | 计划书十三补 1.5（作者） | 真源必填字段 | 是，加载期校验 | 已追认 |
| 测试夹具里的伪戳必须保持哈希形状 | 本包测试套件 | 陷阱：全数字值会被 YAML 解析成数字，于是拒绝报的是缺戳而不是不匹配 | 篡改用例里点名 | 不适用，记录于此以免下一个夹具再踩 |
| 三条引用读数（0.007–0.024 ms、20.84%、12/12） | 协调检出处的证据表 | 外部引用 | 否 —— 不是本包测量值 | 不适用，已按时点与摘要声明为引用 |
| `behaviorDelta` 的定义 | 本包提案（第 3 块） | 已实现的机械口径 | 是：每轮留痕，且**本包不据此主张任何墙纸率** | **【待作者追认】** |

### 关于 `behaviorDelta` 的限定原文

轮次还报告每条曝光判据所覆盖的动作在其观察窗口内**是否复现**——这是墙纸率所需的**分子**。定义是机械的：判据在一轮里**到达模型**即为"曝光"（被注入，或被 deny/提醒/对账据以行动），窗口 = 其后 `exposureWindowRounds` 个**部署级轮次**。状态只有三种，且彼此**不同形**：`recurred`、`held`、`unobserved`。**不覆盖任何动作的判据不出现在其中**，因为"这里什么也没观察到"与"观察到了、没有复现"不是同一件事。距离按**本轮**写，因此不会回退；判决在窗口关闭时定下，其后到达的调用不会把 `held` 追认成 `recurred`。

这份留痕给出的是**可区分性与可检性，不是正确性**。三种状态文本不同、距离能区分同一状态的两次观察、两个时钟读数让距离**可重算**（`roundsSinceExposure` 必须等于 `behaviorRound - exposedAtRound`，由本包不变量保证）——而不是听信产出者的说法。但状态与距离由同一次计算产出，**两边一起算错**仍会通过：不变量证明的是记录**不自相矛盾**，不是观察正确。**这是一个自选的机械口径，在作者追认之前不应据此主张任何墙纸率。**

## 发布形态与类型可见性

**随包发的文件**（`files` 白名单，tarball 实际 20 个）：`dsh/`（`index.js`、`invariant.js` 与两个
`.js.map`、`index.d.ts`、`invariant.d.ts`）、`cordis.patch.yml`、`eval/` 的 3 个文件、
`examples/fixtures/oikonomia-eye/` 的 5 个文件，以及 `package.json`、`README.md`、`LICENSE`、`NOTICE`、
`CHANGELOG.md`。本包**没有** `dist/`，也**没有** CLI 或客户端半边。
`files` 里还列着 `skills` 与 `docs` 两个**并不存在**的目录：npm 会静默跳过它们，因此 tarball 里没有，
这不是打包缺陷；两处是给尚未搬入的内容留的位（见 [RISKS.md](RISKS.md) R10）。

**消费方怎么拿到类型**：`exports["."]` 是 `{ types: ./dsh/index.d.ts, default: ./dsh/index.js }`，
所以 TypeScript 按包名解析本包时读的就是 `dsh/index.d.ts`。

**合并键就在那个文件里。** 本包向两个宿主类型表各加一个键：

| 宿主包 | 类型表 | 本包加入的键 |
|---|---|---|
| `@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm` | `MessageSourceMap` | `'oikonomia-eye'` |
| `@deepseek-ai/dsh-session/types` | `SessionEventMap` | `'coordinate/round'` |

`declare module` 只在**读到了该声明的那个程序**里生效。`tsup` 的声明构建把程序摇到只剩包根可导出的
符号，而 `src/types.ts` 是纯类型模块、导出全被擦除，于是这两处 augment 被整个裁掉。因此
`scripts/inject-augments.mjs` 在构建后把它们从 `src/types.ts` 的 `#augment:emit` 标记区**逐字节复制**
进 `dsh/index.d.ts` —— 那是每个 `import` 本包的消费者必然加载的文件，所以 augment 必然进入消费者程序。
脚本不在自己这里重抄一遍声明，源码是唯一真源；标记缺失即报错退出，不会悄悄少发一个键。

**消费方需要做什么：只 `import` 本包。** 不需要 `import type {} from 'dsh-oikonomia-eye/types'`，
不需要 `/// <reference types="..." />`，不需要 `tsconfig` 里的 `types` 或 `paths`，也不需要自己写一份
同形 augment。装了 `peerDependencies`（两个宿主包）就能读到键：

```ts
import 'dsh-oikonomia-eye'
import type { SessionEventMap } from '@deepseek-ai/dsh-session/types'

const key: keyof SessionEventMap = 'coordinate/round'   // 编译通过
type Round = SessionEventMap['coordinate/round']        // 就是本包的 CoordinateRound
```

**唯一的边界**：只 `import 'dsh-oikonomia-eye/invariant'`、从不 `import` 包根时，消费者程序不加载
`dsh/index.d.ts`，因此看不到这两个键。`invariant` 子路径是给组合里的伴随插件用的，它自己不带
`OikonomiaEyeSource`/`CoordinateRound` 的声明，把 augment 复制进去会引入未定义名，所以**只注入包根**；
组合里挂本包时加载的正是包根，所以正常部署不受影响。

**怎么确认发出去的东西是对的**：`pnpm run check-pack` 除文件表外，还读出**真 tarball 里**
`dsh/index.d.ts` 的 `declare module` 行并在一个都没有时判 FAIL；`pnpm run augment:check` 是不写文件的
漂移检查（`--check` 模式）。`pnpm run build` 可重复执行，连跑两次产物逐字节相同。

`DSH_OIKONOMIA_EYE_NO_DTS=1` 的 `build:no-dts` 只是类型阻塞期的逃生门：它**不**产出声明，因此
**不是**可发布形态 —— 那样打出的 tarball 里没有 `dsh/index.d.ts`，消费方拿不到任何类型，更拿不到合并键。
`npm publish` 的 `prepack`/`prepare` 会走正常的 `build`，所以从打包路径发布时声明总是带 augment 的。
