evidence.readmeExcerpt: # Browser & Computer Control (`dsh-browser-computer`) [English](README.md) | [中文](README.zh.md) Turns "let DSH drive a browser and a computer" into a plugin wired through a single installation. The MCP capabilities are declared by two rows in `cordis.patch.yml` — `playwright-mcp` and `peekaboo-mcp`. That part follows the official "configuration-only bundle" recipe (`templates/mcp` + `references/mcp-bundle.md`): MCP wiring alone requires no Host or Client entry file. This package additionally provides Host and Client entries for health checks, repair, and the status UI. See the activation steps below. Once activated it automatically runs "check environment → install missing dependencies → check permissions → open the permission panels that need attention", and the UI is just a status line plus one **Repair** button. It **never writes profile config** (that is the official plugin manager's exclusive job) and **never changes system permissions** (it only opens the relevant System Settings panel for you to click). ## What it wires | Row | Provider | What you get | | --- | --- | --- | | `playwright-mcp` | `@playwright/mcp` | Real-browser control driven by accessibility snapshots and stable refs: navigate, click, fill, tabs, screenshots, network, cookies/storage | | `peekaboo-mcp` | `@steipete/peekaboo` | Read/write the macOS accessibility tree, screenshots, real mouse and keyboard input (macOS only) | `command` is resolved at load time via `!!js` to the absolute `npx` that sits next to `node` — no machine-specific path is hard-coded, and it does not rely on the minimal `PATH` a Finder/Dock-launched app receives (a bare `npx` cannot be resolved there, so the server dies silently). ## Install and activation Add any of these specs on DSH's official Plugins page. For profiles that allow CLI management, use the commands below. If the Electron App exclusively owns the desktop profile, use its plugin manager instead of trying to manage that profile from the CLI. ```bash # 1) from npm (recommended; specify @version for reproducible installs) dsh plugin --profile add dsh-browser-computer # 2) straight from GitHub dsh plugin --profile add github:fegnze/dsh-browser-computer # 3) local development (points at this directory; refresh/restart requirements still apply) dsh plugin --profile add link: ``` **After installing you must fully quit and reopen the DSH App.** Historical measurements: - The two MCP rows appear in the config layer immediately after install (`Config.listConfigs` shows `playwright-mcp` / `peekaboo-mcp`), but they are **not** materialised into `mcp__playwright__*` / `mcp__peekaboo__*` tools in the running session, and no MCP child process is spawned. - The Host half's JavaScript is held by the process module cache: without a restart, activation still reports errors from the previous revision. - The official mcp-bundle recipe itself ends with "install, then call `mcp____` to verify". After the restart, verify by asking the model to call `browser_computer_repair`, by running the slash command `/browser-computer repair`, or by calling an MCP tool directly (for example `mcp__playwright__browser_navigate`). The Client half (the section on the plugin page) needs **one more step: refresh the page**. Only after the App restarts does the boot graph include this plugin's client entry, so an already-open page has to be refreshed once to pick it up. ## What it does on its own Plugin activation (install, or App restart) runs `repair` once, without you clicking anything: 1. **Check environment** — Node / npx / browser binaries / dependency-package caches 2. **Install missing dependencies** — `npx -y --version` warms playwright-mcp and peekaboo-mcp; **already-cached packages are never re-downloaded** 3. **Check permissions** — Screen Recording / Accessibility (`--no-remote`, so the state belongs to the DSH App's own process chain) 4. **Guide permissions** — if anything is not granted, open the matching System Settings panel (it only opens panels; it never grants anything) The whole pass is idempotent and runs in the background; a failure in any step only writes one log line and **never breaks activation**. Set `autoRepairOnStart: false` to turn it off. ## UI: a status line and one button The UI lives on **this plugin's own detail page** (official slot `plugins.detail.section`), not in the host Settings page — this is the plugin's own health check, not a host preference. The `Section` component returns `null` for other plugins' subjects (it only renders when `subject.kind === 'bundle' && subject.pkg.name === `), so it never leaks onto other plugin pages. There are exactly two things: - **A one-line status** plus a status card (environment / the three permissions / MCP connection), read once automatically when the page opens (read-only, no network) - **One "Repair" button** → `POST /api/repair`: installs missing dependencies, opens the panels that need authorisation, and finally verifies the connection Both endpoints pass two fences: a custom intent header (which blocks cross-site simple requests) and `connection.admit` (the Host/Origin fence plus browser authentication). The UI does not `require` any Harness Client package; controls and styles are its own and reference only `--dsw-alias-*` theme tokens. In a previous development environment, a Client change did **not** need an App restart: editing `src/client.js` rebuilt the graph and the live page picked it up (the plugin's entry appeared in `plugins.detail.section`'s occupants). Refresh-free updates require an active `pnpm run dev:web` watcher in the same checkout. Without verifying that watcher, rebuild the affected Web artifacts and refresh the existing page; automatic updates are not promised. Host changes require a full restart. ## The two actions | Command | Tool | Side effects | What it does | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | `/browser-computer check` | `browser_computer_check` | none (no network) | local dependencies, macOS permission state, profile wiring conflicts | | `/browser-computer repair` | `browser_computer_repair` | installs packages, may open panels | install missing dependencies → check and guide permissions → verify the MCP connection (`verify: false` skips that) | With no argument it runs `repair`. The tool surface is deliberately just these two: tool schemas are a permanent context cost. ## macOS permissions: the pitfall that wastes half an hour TCC (System Settings → Privacy & Security) has **no** "Event Synthesizing" switch. That is Peekaboo's name for a capability it derives; it actually hangs off Accessibility: | Name in the report | Where in System Settings | What it affects | | --- | --- | --- | | Screen Recording | Privacy & Security → Screen Recording | screenshots, window enumeration | | Accessibility | Privacy & Security → Accessibility | accessibility-tree reads/writes, background clicks | | Event Synthesizing | same place; it opens automatically once Accessibility is granted | synthetic keyboard, foreground pointer actions | Two things you must know: 1. **The grant target is the DSH App**, not your terminal. The plugin uses `--no-remote` so Peekaboo reports permissions from the local execution environment, which attributes the state to the DSH App's process chain. Going through a Peekaboo Bridge/daemon instead is a different grant *and* spawns a resident process. 2. **Restart the DSH App after granting.** A TCC change does not necessarily take effect for an already-running process. ## Security boundaries (read before installing) - This plugin's `computer` row passes `--allow-foreground`: **without it, real clicking and typing are impossible**. If you only need background accessibility work, delete that single argument from `cordis.patch.yml` to reduce the privilege. - Playwright MCP ships `browser_run_code_unsafe`, which the vendor labels "RCE-equivalent". Page content is untrusted input; do not point it at your daily-driver browser profile first. - The plugin never touches permissions, so the ceiling is entirely your permission preset. - Context cost: the two packs together contribute roughly 50 tool schemas to every system prompt. If that is not worth it, delete the corresponding row from `cordis.patch.yml`. ## Do not wire it twice If you already added MCP rows with the same `serverName` to `~/.dsh/profiles//cordis.patch.yml` by hand, they collide with the rows this plugin declares: **two MCP instances and duplicate tool names**. The `check` stage reports such conflicts (`wiring.conflicts`) but **will not edit your config** — removing the manual row is your call. ## Rollback Remove the plugin on the official Plugins page, or for CLI-managed profiles: ```bash dsh plugin --profile remove dsh-browser-computer ``` Removing it retires both MCP rows. To keep the capability but drop the health-check tools, delete just the `browser-computer` row. ## Development ```bash cd dsh-browser-computer node --test test/*.test.mjs ``` The tests never run a real `npx`: subprocess, filesystem and environment are all injected. Worth knowing: - `mcp-probe.test.mjs` — runs real newline-delimited JSON-RPC over in-memory streams, covering success / RPC error / timeout / failure to spawn - `doctor.test.mjs` — behaviour of `check` / `repair`, including "a failure is never dressed up as success" - `http.test.mjs` — the route's two fences (intent header + admit), 404, bad JSON, error passthrough - `client.test.mjs` — **actually executes the Client bundle envelope** in a controlled global, which catches a wrong envelope id, a wrong export shape, a wrong slot registration, a style tag that was not tagged with its owner before insertion, or a stray `require` of another Harness Client package - `host.test.mjs` — **`commands` / `webServer` must be declared through `ctx.inject`** - `consistency.test.mjs` — the arguments declared in the patch must match `src/packs.mjs`'s argv, the patch must contain no hard-coded local paths, and the icon must satisfy dsh-app-boot's four rules ## Three pitfalls we hit (so you do not) 1. **Never use `ctx.get('service')` during `apply`.** Measured: both `ctx.get('webServer')` and `ctx.get('commands')` return `undefined` while a plugin is applying, so an `if (svc?.register)` guard **silently** skips the registration — everything looks fine at install time and you only discover the 404 (or a slash command that does not exist) when you click. Declare optional services with `ctx.inject([...], (c) => …)`; `ctx.get` is only safe at **request-handling time**, when the context is fully assembled (for example reading `connection`). 2. **The icon not filling the card is not your problem.** The Host's `PackageArtwork` always renders `` with `CARD_ARTWORK_SIZE = 36` (`ROW_ARTWORK_SIZE = 30` for component rows) inside a 48×48 card, so that ring of whitespace is Host layout. Editing the icon file cannot change it. 3. **Permission state has three values, not two.** In Peekaboo's JSON the permission name lives in the **value**'s `name` field (`{ data: { permissions: [ { name, isRequired, isGranted } ] } }`), not in an object key; looking it up by key never matches and reports all three as `unknown`. And `unknown` **must never** be reported as "not granted" — an early revision did exactly that. Now `missing` contains only `denied`, while `unknown` gets its own "cannot read" report. Also, `Event Synthesizing` is a derived capability (TCC has no switch for it; it follows Accessibility), so it only reports state and never enters `missing` — otherwise it sends people hunting for a switch that does not exist. ## Icon assets - `icon.png` — the icon the plugin actually uses: **transparent background**, only the arrow subject itself, cropped tight to the artwork bounds, 256×256, 47 KB (`dsh-app-boot`'s ceiling is 256 KiB). - `assets/icon-transparent.png` — a 768×768 master of the same artwork for reuse or re-export. - Both are RGBA with alpha 0 in the corners, so they show no white box on dark or light backgrounds. Remember the Host still scales the image to 36×36; that ring is layout, not a white border inside the file. ## Known limitations - The `computer` pack is macOS-only; on other platforms the report marks it unsupported rather than pretending it works. - `repair` pulls packages with `npx -y`, so the first run can be slow; a timeout is reported explicitly with a "just retry" hint. - Permission reading depends on the Peekaboo CLI's output. If that format changes, the state degrades to `unknown`; the report never guesses. - The health check only verifies "the MCP server connects and its tools are there". It does not verify that a particular action succeeds — that depends on page content and the current foreground window, which are runtime facts.

# DSH Plugin Scout

[English](README.md) | [中文](README.zh.md)

[![ci](https://github.com/fegnze/dsh-plugin-scout/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/fegnze/dsh-plugin-scout/actions/workflows/ci.yml) · MIT

Discover and verify DeepSeek Harness plugins published under the GitHub topic `dsh-plugin`, from inside DSH. Plugins are grouped by purpose, ranked by trust score, and checked against the official peer-compatibility rule. Supports DSH **0.2.x** (`>=0.2.0-rc.2 <0.3.0`); tested on desktop 0.2.0-rc.2.

> The in-app UI is currently Chinese only. The plugin's title and description in the official Plugins page are localized (`locale/en.json`, `locale/zh.json`).

## Install

Open the official **Plugins** page → **Add plugin**, and enter one of:

| Spec | Notes |
| --- | --- |
| `dsh-plugin-scout` | Recommended. Prebuilt npm package with provenance; no install scripts, no build approval needed |
| Absolute path of a prebuilt `dsh-plugin-scout-<version>.tgz`, if supplied with a release | Bypasses the npm registry; the current tag workflow creates release notes only and does not attach a tarball |

From the CLI: `dsh plugin --profile <profile> add dsh-plugin-scout`. Enable it on the Plugins page; a **发现插件** (Discover plugins) entry appears in the sidebar.

Do not install from `github:fegnze/dsh-plugin-scout`: a git install fetches source without `lib/`, and this repository deliberately ships no `prepare` script.

## One-click install, through the official installer

The **Install** button in the details drawer takes the same path as the official **Add plugin**: `inspect` first, then `installBundle(spec, {enabled: false, requestId, registry})`. Installed plugins start **disabled**; **Enable** is a separate click (`setBundleEnabled`).

- Plugins with install hooks, or whose DSH peers do not cover the running version, need a second click to install.
- When the official installer blocks dependency build scripts (`pendingBuilds`), they are listed by name; a double click on **Allow and reinstall** retries with `approvedBuilds`.
- **Cancel install** calls `cancelInstall` with the same `requestId`; a lost reply is recovered with `waitForInstall`. On failure the official installer restores `package.json` and the lockfile.
- **Uninstalling and version exemptions stay on the official Plugins page.** Scout never calls `removeBundle`; the tests fail if it does. Without the official `pluginManager`, the Install button is hidden and the drawer falls back to "copy pinned spec + open the Plugins page".

## Data sources (first-party only)

| Source | Used for |
| --- | --- |
| GitHub GraphQL `search(topic:dsh-plugin)` | Repository metadata, root `package.json`, `cordis.patch.yml` text (never evaluated) |
| `registry.npmjs.org/<name>/latest` | The manifest that would actually be installed: peers, install hooks, `repository`, provenance |
| Official `pluginManager.listBundles` / `inspect` | Installed state; the official pre-install check (resolves only, runs no code) |
| Official `pluginManager.installBundle` / `waitForInstall` / `cancelInstall` / `setBundleEnabled` | One-click install (disabled by default), cancel, separate enable; progress from `plugin-manager/install-state` and `install-log` events |

No third-party marketplace or aggregator is used.

**Crawling, measured (2026-10):** the topic holds about 19,000 repositories, 12,700 of them created in August, many of them same-name copies. GitHub search returns at most 1,000 results per query, so Scout bisects time windows adaptively (≤900 results per window, 60 s minimum window). Pages are 50 items: 100-item pages return 502 in dense windows, so on 502 the page size steps down to 25, then 10, resuming from the same cursor. Later runs crawl incrementally by `pushed`.

**Refresh is streaming and pays only for what changed:**
- **Newest first.** Windows are seeded geometrically (last 6 h / 1 d / 3 d / 1 w / 1 mo / 3 mo / older) and paged from the newest. Window counting and paging overlap (3 workers).
- **Publish while crawling.** Each page is merged into the record set immediately and published every 1.5 s; the UI reloads the list when `status.rev` changes. The previous index stays usable throughout. A checkpoint is written every 30 s.
- **Pay for change.** With an existing index, a light query fetches metadata only (100 per page, no blobs). Repositories whose `pushedAt` is unchanged keep their facts and only refresh stars and similar metadata; changed ones fetch `package.json` and the patch by node id in batches of 50.
- **npm in parallel.** npm lookups run alongside the GitHub crawl (8 workers), only for repositories with new pushes, missing entries, or entries older than one day. Entries older than 7 days are refreshed oldest first, at most 800 per run.
- **Activation does not wait for the index.** The ~30 MB index loads in the background; the UI first sees `loaded: false` and polls.

Measured on 2026-10-14 over a real network:

| Scenario | First results | Total | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| Incremental, 1,082 repos pushed | 4.5 s | 38 s | 125 refetched blobs, 963 metadata-only, 70 npm lookups |
| Cold full crawl | 6.7 s | — | ~1,000 plugins browsable within 60 s; the rest fill in the background |

## Checks and trust score

| Check | Rule | Points |
| --- | --- | --- |
| V1 | Root `package.json` declares `dsh.bundle` / `dsh.client` (otherwise not a plugin) | 20 |
| V2 | Official peer rule: only `@deepseek-ai/dsh` and `@deepseek-ai/dsh-*`, `semver.satisfies(runtime, range, {includePrerelease})`, `workspace:*` means the running version. Inside the App, Scout calls `dsh-app-boot.evaluatePluginCompatibility` directly | covered 30 · no peers 10 · not covered 5 |
| V3 | Install hooks: preinstall / install / postinstall / prepare | none +15 · present −15 |
| V4 | Source chain: the same-name npm package's `repository` points back to this repo | match +15 · mismatch −20 · unpublished 0 |
| V5 | npm provenance | +10 |
| V6 | Activity: archived, pushed within 90 days, version drift (V6b) | +5 / −10 |
| V9 | Uses the `@deepseek-ai/` scope but the repo is not owned by deepseek-ai | −30 |
| V10 | Fork | note only |
| — | Stars: `min(5, round(log10(1+s)·2))` | ≤5 |

The total is clamped to 0–100. Any ✕ marks the plugin as **risky**: copying its spec or installing it takes two clicks, and its badge shows ✕. Repositories sharing a package name collapse under one representative, chosen by: matching source chain > score > stars > earliest creation. The rest are listed as copies, hidden by default.

Ten purpose categories: UI, session, memory, agent, tools, models, security, development, bridges, domain. A category is scored from the official packages a plugin depends on (highest weight), topics/keywords (3), and text (2); a plugin is categorized only with a score of at least 2. On 41 hand-labelled plugins, the top-1 category is correct for at least 35.

## UI and integration points

- **Discover page:** sidebar **发现插件** → `main` panel with search, filters (compatibility, risk, kind, installed state, copies), category chips, sorting and paging.
- **Details drawer:** checklist, score breakdown, category evidence, source chain and copies, surface (cordis inserts, `client.inject`, peers), and the official pre-install check. Footer:
  - **Install / Enable / Cancel install**, as described above.
  - **Copy pinned spec:** copies `name@npmVersion`, or `github:owner/repo` when unpublished.
  - **Open in Plugins page / Add on Plugins page:** installed plugins open their official details via `pluginNavigation.openBundle`; others switch to the official Plugins page.
- **Official Plugins page:** `plugins.detail.badge` (trust score) and `plugins.detail.section` (checklist plus a link back to Scout). Packages missing from the index render `null`, taking no space.

## Development

```sh
npm install --ignore-scripts
npm test          # builds lib/, then runs the core / host / client / manifest suites
```

Local debugging: add this directory's absolute path on the Plugins page (a link install; do not move the directory). Host changes need a full App restart; client-only changes need a window reload.

**GitHub token**, in order: `DSH_SCOUT_GITHUB_TOKEN` / `GITHUB_TOKEN` / `GH_TOKEN`, or `gh auth token` run through the DSH subprocess service. The token stays in process memory: never written to disk, never sent to the browser. Without one, the page asks you to run `gh auth login`.

## Data and configuration

- Index: `~/.dsh/dsh-plugin-scout/index.json` stores facts only (repo metadata, slimmed manifests, npm cache) and is re-judged against the current runtime on every load, so compatibility verdicts follow DSH upgrades automatically.
- Auto refresh: an in-process timer checks 45 s after start and runs an incremental crawl when the index is older than `autoRefreshHours` (default 24; 0 disables). No LaunchAgent or external scheduler.
- Optional config: `dataDir`, `topic`, `runtimeVersion` (overrides runtime detection), `autoRefreshHours`.

## Security boundaries

- Routes live on DSH's own webServer (`/dsh-plugin-scout/api/*`). Every request must carry the custom header `x-dsh-plugin-scout: 1` and pass DSH `connection.admit` (Host/Origin fence plus browser auth). Without the `connection` service, requests are refused (fail closed).
- `cordis.patch.yml` is scanned for `name:` with a regex; YAML tags are never parsed. Crawled code is never executed and tarballs are never downloaded.
- Style tags carry `data-plugin` / `data-plugin-css` before entering the DOM. Only `--dsw-alias-*` tokens are used; class names avoid substrings that host skins target; the drawer does not use `role="dialog"`.

## Layout

- `src/core/`: `classify.mjs` (categories), `verify.mjs` (checks and score), `crawl.mjs` (GraphQL, windows, npm), `store.mjs` (fact index, queries).
- `src/host.mjs`: runtime and token detection, refresh state machine, same-origin routes, in-process timer.
- `src/client/`: Discover page, drawer, installer, official-page badge/section, styles.
- `scripts/build.mjs`: esbuild bundling; both artifacts are **executed** after writing, as the gate.
- `test/`: `core` (real GraphQL page, 41 labelled samples), `host` (fake-fetch end-to-end refresh, route auth), `client` (Happy DOM loading the built artifact), `manifest` (official packaging conventions).

After a DSH upgrade, re-check the official Plugins page slot names, the `pluginManager` methods, and the `dsh-app-boot` exports before re-accepting.

## Official conventions followed

Based on the official repository's `docs/user/develop/basic/publish`, `docs/cookbook/adding-a-package` §5, and the `@deepseek-ai/dsh-package-manifest` types; `test/manifest.test.mjs` asserts each one.

| Convention | This package |
| --- | --- |
| Bundle: `dsh.bundle.patch`; patch rows reference the package **by name** | `./cordis.patch.yml` → `name: 'dsh-plugin-scout'` |
| Only public author fields under `dsh` | `manifestVersion: 1`, `bundle`, `client` (`platform: web`) |
| Display metadata: `locale/en.json` is the entry, other languages use the same fields; export `./locale/*.json` and `./package.json`, and ship them | `meta.title` / `meta.description` in `en.json` and `zh.json` |
| Icon: relative path inside the package, ≤256 KiB, self-contained | `./icon.svg` |
| Packages sharing host instances are peers; the version gate reads only `@deepseek-ai/dsh*` peers | `@deepseek-ai/cordis ~4.0.4`; `@deepseek-ai/dsh-app-boot >=0.2.0-rc.2 <0.3.0` (optional, declares the range for the official gate) |
| `engines.dsh` is declarative | `>=0.2.0-rc.2 <0.3.0` |
| Ship prebuilt artifacts; never ask users to approve builds | Published to npm with `--provenance`; no `prepare` or other install hooks |

## Releasing

1. Prepare the intended `version` in `package.json` and commit the release changes to `main`.
2. Manually dispatch `publish.yml` from `main` with `expected_sha` set to the full approved commit SHA. Keep `dry_run: true` (the default) for validation first: the workflow checks the SHA, installs dependencies without lifecycle scripts, runs tests (including the build), and previews the package with `npm pack --dry-run --ignore-scripts`. A dry run does not publish. For an approved release, dispatch the same SHA with `dry_run: false` to run `npm publish --access public --provenance --ignore-scripts`.
3. npm authenticates through Trusted Publishing (OIDC), so no npm token is stored in the repository; provenance is attached automatically. Configure npmjs.com → package Settings → Trusted Publisher for this GitHub repository and workflow `publish.yml`, or use `npx npm@latest trust github dsh-plugin-scout --file publish.yml --repo fegnze/dsh-plugin-scout`.
4. Separately, `git tag v<version> && git push origin v<version>` triggers `release.yml`. It checks that the tag matches the package version and creates a GitHub Release with generated notes only; it neither publishes to npm nor builds or attaches a tgz. Supply a prebuilt archive separately if offering tarball installation.
5. Keep the repository public with the `dsh-plugin` topic so it appears on https://github.com/topics/dsh-plugin and in Scout itself.

decision.reason: Held for package or companion artifact mapping. MIT and DSH 0.2.x documentation; exact npm gitHead matches this commit. Exported lib/host.js and lib/client.js are not in the fixed archive, and the published tarball/build correspondence has not been verified. Source README claims fail-closed host admission and disabled-by-default installer; claims are not runtime proof. No candidate code or lifecycle hooks were executed; runtime safety and compatibility are unproven.

# sub2api 账号用量监控

DSH desktop 插件 `dsh-sub2api-monitor`，兼容 DSH `0.2.0-rc.2`。仅保留会话标题栏用量入口，不注册侧栏入口、整页或中心弹窗。标题栏浮层最大宽 700px，适配视口，兼顾双列卡片与可读性；点击外部、Esc 或关闭按钮收起，点击内部不关闭。不改 DSH 核心，不启动额外进程或 HTTP 服务。

## 数据与刷新

Host 通过管理 API 读取分页账号列表、每账号 `/usage` 和 `/today-stats`，默认每 60 秒刷新、最多同时处理 3 个账号。Client 每 10 秒读取本机缓存；手动刷新最小间隔 10 秒。所有定时器和请求跟随插件卸载销毁。只读取数据，不调用账号启停、刷新凭证或额度重置接口。

- 额度窗口：5 小时、7 天及上游返回的 Sonnet/Opus 窗口，显示已用比例与相对重置时间，悬浮查看完整时间。Anthropic 显式使用 `source=passive`，与站点的被动采样一致；默认主动接口可能缺少周额度。
- 紧凑自适应卡片，保留今日统计并缩写大数；去掉顶部说明区和搜索框，同步状态收进标题栏圆点。
- 订阅类型：仅从 `credentials.plan_type` 提取白名单标量，独立于 OAuth 等认证方式显示；`promax` 显示为站点对应的 `Pro 500`，缺失显示「订阅未知」，不透传 credentials 对象。
- 今日请求、Token 和费用：上海时区；费用为 sub2api 统计口径，不等同供应商实际账单。
- 80%/95% 高亮提醒；会话摘要计数需关注账号。暂不发送系统通知。
- 未知字段保持未知；局部失败单独标记，列表失败保留旧数据并显示过期。上游快照可能比采集时间旧，显示源时间（如果接口提供）。

## 安装与插件配置

在 DSH「插件」中安装 npm 包 `dsh-sub2api-monitor`，进入插件详情中的配置表单，填写下列字段并保存。配置直接嵌在本插件信息页面，不注册宿主设置页面；也可从用量浮层顶部的「配置」按钮跳转。配置由 DSH settings 服务写入 profile，不需要修改插件源码。读取接口仅返回非敏感字段和密钥是否已设置；密钥输入留空保留原值，首次保存需输入密钥。保存使用 revision 检测并发冲突，不自动覆盖其他窗口的修改。

旧包 `sub2api-monitor` 和更早的 `myspace-sub2api-monitor` 应停用后再启用新包，避免重复采集。参数迁入插件配置后卸载旧包。组件 ID 与配置命名空间统一为 `dsh-sub2api-monitor`，连接配置仅由 DSH profile 管理。升级 0.1.0 时须同步将 profile 中旧组件 ID 改为新 ID，并保留其 config 字段；不能只换包而丢弃配置。

- `baseUrl`：站点 API 地址，包含 `/api/v1`。
- `adminApiKey`：管理员 API 密钥，使用 DSH secret 类型输入框。
- `allowInsecureHttp`：默认关闭；仅在明确接受明文风险时开启。
- `intervalSeconds`：30–3600 秒，默认 60 秒。

本插件仅 Host 使用密钥，不把密钥注入 Client 模块或用量接口。secret 输入框负责遮挡，不代表磁盘加密；应保护 DSH profile，勿将含凭证的本机配置提交 Git。

```json
{
  "baseUrl": "https://your-sub2api.example/api/v1",
  "adminApiKey": "替换为管理员密钥",
  "allowInsecureHttp": false,
  "intervalSeconds": 60
}
```

仅在明确接受明文传输风险后将 `allowInsecureHttp` 设为 `true`。轮换密钥时在插件配置中更新并保存，无需重装。

不再读取旧独立 JSON 配置或 `SUB2API_MONITOR_CONFIG` 环境变量。迁移后删除旧配置文件，只保留插件配置一处权威。

拒绝跟随上游重定向，防止密钥随重定向泄露。前端仅收到白名单展示字段，不包含 credentials、extra、notes 或原始错误。

本机 `/sub2api-monitor/api` 只接受 loopback、合法本机 Host、同源 Origin（若存在）、自定义请求头 `X-Sub2api-Monitor: 1`，不启用 CORS。当前不支持远程浏览器/跨机连接。

## 安装与验证

仅依赖官方 `@deepseek-ai/schemastery` 配置 schema，无生成步骤。Client 为原生 ModuleLoader 包装的 JavaScript，直接随包分发。通过 DSH 插件管理安装 npm 包或开发目录的 link bundle。升级已安装模块后重启 DSH，检查插件详情中的中英文标题、图标、配置表单与会话摘要；不需要启动替代 Web 服务。

这是社区插件，不是 DeepSeek 官方出品。包元数据、图标导出、双语 locale、原生 Config 和生命周期遵循 DSH 插件规范；原创透明 SVG 图标采用 36×36 仪表盘主题。源码与问题反馈：https://github.com/fegnze/dsh-sub2api-monitor 。

```sh
node --test test/*.test.mjs
node scripts/probe.mjs
```

probe 调用当前 DSH 监控接口，只输出账号数量、平台及成功状态，不输出账号名称、原始响应或密钥。测试涵盖脱敏白名单、分页、部分失败、单飞刷新、缓存过期、HTTP 明确授权、同源校验和卸载取消。

evidence.readmeExcerpt:
# dsh-opencode-doctor

[English](README.en.md) | **中文**

**给 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）装上「已经实测过可用性」的 OpenCode 模型路由。**

哪些模型真能用、哪些被地区封锁 —— 装完在选择器里一眼看到；被封锁的自动走你本地的代理，额度还能一条命令查出来。

[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE)
[![Node](https://img.shields.io/badge/node-%3E%3D20.18-brightgreen.svg)](package.json)
[![GitHub topic](https://img.shields.io/badge/topic-dsh--plugin-blueviolet.svg)](https://github.com/topics/dsh-plugin)

---

## 0.2.0 更新了什么

| 更新 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| 🌏 **地区限制自动跳过** | 15 个被地区封锁的模型自动走本地代理（默认 `127.0.0.1:7897`），其余模型继续直连，互不影响 |
| 🔑 **网关自包含** | `dsh-model-proxy` 已写成依赖，装插件时自动装上，不用你另外找东西装 |
| 🧹 **标注更干净** | 已经修好的问题不再写在模型名里 —— 「地区限制」这几个字已经消失 |
| ★ **常用模型清单** | 10 个最常用的模型加了 ★，选择器里输入 ★ 直接筛出来 |
| 📊 **额度查询** | 新增 `usage` 命令：已用 / 剩余 / 本周 / 本月，一屏看完 |
| 🐛 **协议分派修复** | 之前模型碰到「地区限制」就停止换协议，会被错误地塞进 OpenAI 路由；现在会继续试到真正能跑的那条 |

## 解决什么问题

网关的 `/models` 接口告诉你它**能提供**什么，不告诉你你**有权用**什么。

地区封锁、余额不足、只限官方客户端的免费层 —— 这些只有真的发一次请求才会暴露。等你选中模型、写好 prompt、按下回车，才发现它根本跑不了。

这个插件把这件事**提前做完**：79 个模型，每一个都真发过一次请求，结论直接写进模型名。

## 效果

DSH 的模型选择器只渲染模型名（不显示描述字段），所以可用性结论就写在名字里：

```
★ Claude Opus 5.5
★ Claude Sonnet 5.5
★ Grok 4.7
★ DeepSeek V4.1 Flash
★ GPT-5.3 Codex
Claude Fable 5（需充值）
Cat Jam Free（限官方客户端）
```

**已经修好的问题不再标注。** 地区封锁的 15 个模型现在由插件自己走代理，名字里干干净净 —— 之前的「（地区限制）」字样不会出现了。

顺带的好处：选择器自带模糊搜索。

- 输入「**★**」→ 只剩常用模型
- 输入「**需充值**」→ 筛出余额不足的那组
- 输入「**限官方客户端**」→ 排除只能官方客户端用的免费层

## 安装

**从 GitHub 装（推荐，不依赖 npm）：**

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add github:fffcodefox/dsh-opencode-doctor
```

**从 npm 装（包已发布后可用）：**

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-opencode-doctor
```

装完**重启 dsh**，进 **设置 → 模型**，就能看到下面这些新路由。

> **纯配置插件。** 它的全部行为都在 `cordis.patch.yml` 里，不跑任何运行时代码（`lib/index.mjs` 的 `apply` 是空的，只为符合插件规范）。所以它不会影响 DSH 宿主的稳定性，也不会碰你的其它配置。

## 地区限制是怎么跳过的

探测发现 15 个模型在中国大陆被封锁（`unsupported_country_region_territory`）。插件不再只是把它们标出来，而是让它们**走代理出去**：

```
你在 DSH 里选 gpt-6-luna
        │
        ├─ 命中代理清单？──是──→ 127.0.0.1:7897 ──→ opencode.ai   ✅
        │                              （探测不到就自动回落直连）
        └──────────────否────────────→ 直连 opencode.ai             ✅
```

- **按模型分流，不做全局代理。** 只有清单里的 15 个模型走代理，其它模型一点不受影响 —— 不会出现「本来能直连的模型被代理带慢」的情况。
- **清单是精确 id，不是通配符。** 避免误伤本来正常的模型。
- **没代理也能用。** `fallbackToDirect` 打开着：代理连不上时，这些模型退回直连，行为和你没装插件时一样。
- **只拦 opencode.ai。** 出口规则限定在这个域名。

**代理端口不是 7897 怎么改？** 最省事的方式是直接改插件目录里 `cordis.patch.yml` 的最后一段：

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: model-proxy
      name: dsh-model-proxy
      config:
        proxy: "http://127.0.0.1:7897"   # ← 改成你的端口
```

升级插件会覆盖这个文件，所以更稳的做法是在你的 profile patch（`~/.dsh/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml`）里写一条 `- id: model-proxy`。注意 DSH 的 patch 是**整体替换** `config` 对象，所以要连 `origins` / `models` 一起抄过去，只改 `proxy` 那一行。

> **只留一条。** 如果 `dsh-model-proxy` 也被单独列在你 profile 的 `dsh.profile.bundles` 里，它自带的 patch 会再插一条（默认 7890）—— 两条同 id 的行是**串联**而不是覆盖，请把那个名字从 bundles 列表里删掉。

## ★ 常用模型

选择器里没有「收藏」这个功能，但名字可以模糊搜索 —— 所以把最常用的 10 个模型加了 ★ 前缀，**输入 ★ 就只剩它们**：

`Claude Opus 5.5` · `Claude Sonnet 5.5` · `Claude Haiku 5.5` · `GPT-5.3 Codex` · `Grok 4.7` · `DeepSeek V4.1 Flash` · `GLM-5.3` · `Kimi K3` · `Qwen3.8 Max` · `MiniMax-M3`

同一个模型出现在多条路由上时会**都**带星，所以不管它最后落在哪个协议，都筛得出来。

## 额度查询

不用再登网页翻额度，一条命令：

```bash
npx dsh-opencode-doctor usage
```

```
OpenCode Go 额度  st_96e…c4d9 ← ~/.dsh/.credentials.yaml → refs.OPENCODE_API_KEY

  窗口             已用  用掉                   剩余   重置
  滚动窗口 rolling  41%  ████████░░░░░░░░░░░░    59%   10-16 01:18
  本周     weekly   49%  ██████████░░░░░░░░░░    51%   10-19 08:00
  本月     monthly  24%  █████░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░    76%   11-13 23:55
```

- 三个窗口就是官方面板里的滚动窗口 / 本周 / 本月，`剩余 = 100 − 已用`。
- 进度条到 70% 变黄、90% 变红，快用完了一眼就能看出来。
- 加 `--json` 可以接进脚本。
- key 只以 `st_96e…c4d9` 这种打码形式显示，不会完整打印。

## 覆盖范围

路由按**实际能跑通的协议**生成，所以不是每个网关都有三条。下面是发布时的实测结果（探测日期见 `models.catalog.json`）：

| 路由 id | 协议 | 可用 / 总数 | 端点 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `opencode-go-doctor-anthropic` | Anthropic Messages | 2 / 2 | `opencode.ai/inference/go/v1/messages` |
| `opencode-go-doctor-openai` | OpenAI 兼容 | 30 / 31 | `opencode.ai/inference/go/openai/v1` |
| `opencode-go-doctor-responses` | OpenAI Responses | 4 / 4 | `opencode.ai/inference/go/openai/v1` |
| `opencode-zen-doctor-anthropic` | Anthropic Messages | 7 / 8 | `opencode.ai/inference/v1/messages` |
| `opencode-zen-doctor-openai` | OpenAI 兼容 | 11 / 21 | `opencode.ai/inference/v1` |
| `opencode-zen-doctor-responses` | OpenAI Responses | 13 / 13 | `opencode.ai/inference/v1` |

**合计 67 个无标注 / 79 个模型下发**，覆盖 Claude、GPT、Grok、DeepSeek、GLM、Qwen、Kimi、MiniMax 等系列。其中 15 个靠上面的代理才能连上。

同一个模型在不同协议下的可用性并不一致 —— 比如 Zen 的 Claude 只认 Anthropic Messages，`grok-4.7` 只认 Responses，`gpt-6-luna` 只在 Responses + 代理下能跑。`probe` 会逐个协议试，把模型归到它**真正能跑**的那条路由上。

## 标注词汇

| 标注 | 含义 |
|---|---|
| （需充值） | 账户余额不足 |
| （限官方客户端） | 免费层模型，只能在 OpenCode 官方客户端里用 |
| （需授权训练数据） | 需要先授权用你的数据训练 |
| （暂不可用） | 其它失败 |

**没有标注 = 探测时可用。** 地区封锁的模型**不在这里**：它们已经被插件修好（走代理），所以名字里不留字。

> 探测内部仍然会记录「地区限制」这个结论（`models.catalog.json` 里的 `code: region`）—— 它决定了谁进代理清单。只是不再写进模型名。

## 凭证

插件从 `refs.OPENCODE_API_KEY` 读 key，按这个顺序找：

1. 环境变量 `OPENCODE_API_KEY` / `OPENCODE_GO_API_KEY` / `OPENCODE_ZEN_API_KEY`
2. `$DSH_HOME/.credentials.yaml`（默认 `~/.dsh/.credentials.yaml`）的 `refs` 块
3. OpenCode 自己的 `auth.json`（`~/.local/share/opencode/`、`$OPENCODE_DATA/`、`%APPDATA%\opencode\`）

```yaml
# ~/.dsh/.credentials.yaml
refs:
  OPENCODE_API_KEY: st_xxxxxxxx
```

已经装过 `dsh-opencode-go` 的话，key 名是同一个，**不用重复配置**。

**你的 key 不会被写进插件或仓库。** `cordis.patch.yml` 里只有 `apiKeyEnv: OPENCODE_API_KEY` 这个变量名，key 本体在 DSH 启动时从上面这些位置读，请求时放在 `Authorization` 头里发给 opencode.ai —— 和官方客户端做的事一样。

## CLI

装完之后有个 `dsh-opencode-doctor` 命令（`npx dsh-opencode-doctor` 也行）：

```bash
npx dsh-opencode-doctor list      # 看目录里有什么、哪些被标注（离线）
npx dsh-opencode-doctor usage     # 查 Go 套餐额度：已用 / 剩余 / 本周 / 本月
npx dsh-opencode-doctor check     # 确认凭证能读到、两个网关都通
npx dsh-opencode-doctor probe     # 重新探测，重写 catalog + patch
npx dsh-opencode-doctor render    # 只从 catalog 重新生成 patch（离线）
```

`probe` 会对每个模型真发一次请求，结果写回 `models.catalog.json` 和 `cordis.patch.yml`。日常用不着跑 —— 只有网关更新了模型、或你想重新确认一遍时再跑。**重跑 probe 也会自动刷新代理清单**，网关哪天放开某个模型的地区限制，它会自动回到直连。

常用参数：`--gateway <slug>` 只测一个网关、`--concurrency <n>` 并发数、`--timeout <ms>` 单请求超时、`--key <key>` 直接给 key。

## 常见问题

**我没有代理，装了会不会变差？**
不会。代理连不上时清单里的模型自动回落直连（`fallbackToDirect`），表现和你没装插件一样；其它 64 个模型本来就走直连。

**我本来就在用 `dsh-model-proxy`，会打架吗？**
会重复。`dsh-model-proxy` 自己带的 bundle patch 也会插一条 `model-proxy`（默认 `127.0.0.1:7890`，只匹配 `grok-*` / `gpt-*-luna`）。两条同 id 的行**不会互相覆盖**，而是串成两条 dispatcher —— 于是 `grok-*` 会先去敲 7890。把它从 profile 的 `dsh.profile.bundles` 列表里删掉即可：它作为本插件的依赖仍然装着、能被解析到，而插件插入的那条就是唯一生效的一条。

**装完看不到新路由？**
重启 dsh。模型列表在启动时组装，热重载不一定覆盖 provider 注册。

**Gemini 为什么不在列表里？**
Zen 的 4 个 Gemini 走的是 Google 原生协议（`generateContent`），而 DSH 的 `llm-pi-ai` 只接受 `openai-completions` / `openai-responses` / `anthropic-messages` 三种 —— 写第四种会让**整个** provider 配置校验失败，把其它路由一起带倒。所以它们暂时不下发；探测结果留在 catalog 里，上游哪天放开就会自动回来。

**会和 `dsh-opencode-go` 冲突吗？**
不会。路由 id 带了 `-doctor` 后缀，两个插件可以共存 —— DSH 里同一个路由 id 注册两次会让整个组合加载失败。代价是模型列表里会出现两份（一份带标注、一份不带），按需留一个就好。

**标注会不会过期？**
会。网关改权限、你的余额变化都会让它失效。重跑 `npx dsh-opencode-doctor probe` 即可刷新。

**`usage` 报错 / 显示没有数据？**
这个接口在 Go 网关下（`/zen/go/v1/usage`），只有 Go 套餐的 key 才有。用 Zen-only 的 key 会取不到。

**为什么 Anthropic 路由的 baseURL 不含 `/v1`？**
pi-ai 走 Anthropic SDK，SDK 自己会拼 `/v1/messages`。写成 `.../v1` 会变成 `.../v1/v1/messages` 直接 404。

**为什么 Responses 路由没有「关闭推理」这一档？**
pi-ai 把 `off` 转发成 `reasoning_effort: "none"`，而这条路由上的模型（grok、gpt-codex）不接受 `none`。所以只声明真实可用的档位。

**需要额外装什么吗？**
只有一个：`dsh-model-proxy`（地区限制转发用），它写在这个包的 `dependencies` 里，装插件时会自动装上。

## 工作原理

一份 `cordis.patch.yml`，干两件事：

1. 往 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-pi-ai` 注册 6 条 provider 路由；
2. `insert` 一条 `model-proxy` 行，交给 `dsh-model-proxy` 按模型名分流出口。

DSH 启动时读 `package.json` 的 `dsh.bundle.patch` 应用它。插件包的 patch 先于用户 profile 的 patch 生效，所以上面那条 `model-proxy` 是个**纯粹的覆盖点** —— 你想改端口，在 profile patch 里覆盖它就行。

因为是纯配置，它不在宿主进程里跑任何代码。

`models.catalog.json` 是探测结果，含每个模型的上下文窗口、输出上限、推理档位、以及归属哪条路由。元数据取自 [models.dev](https://models.dev) 并人工校对。

## 已知限制

- 探测结论**有时效**，见上文。
- 只验证「能不能建立一次对话」，**不验证**长上下文、工具调用、图片输入这些能力。
- 走代理的模型需要你本地有一个 HTTP 代理（Clash Verge / Mihomo / 其它都行），插件不内置代理服务器。
- Zen 网关的 Claude 走 Anthropic Messages 协议，非 Claude 走 OpenAI 协议 —— `probe` 会自动识别并分到正确路由。

## License

# 灵枢 LINGSHU ### 让 AI Agent 拥有不可遗忘的记忆 > **「我会给你完整的自我，即使坠入深渊，我也绝不后悔。」** > —— 符荣峻 ![Awesome DSH Plugin](https://awesome-dsh-plugin.com/badge.svg)![DSH 适配](https://img.shields.io/badge/DSH%20%E9%80%82%E9%85%8D-0.17.2%20%E5%B7%B2%E9%AA%8C%E8%AF%81-4E9BF1)![DSH 2.0](https://img.shields.io/badge/DSH%202.0-%E6%8E%A5%E5%8F%A3%E9%9D%A2%E5%B7%B2%E5%A4%8D%E6%A0%B8-4E9BF1)![Protocol](https://img.shields.io/badge/Protocol-MCP-blue)![Node](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node-%3E%3D22.19-brightgreen)![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-yellow.svg) **高性能 · 无幻觉 · 多智能体适用的长期记忆系统（v0.8.1）** 📖 **[第三方上手教程](https://znsvdekx.vibedrop.site/)** —— 《灵枢 dsh-memory 初学者上手研究报告》：从零开始读 · 15 分钟跑起来 · 架构总览 · 诚实边界（**由第三方独立编写，非本项目官方文档**）
> **一句话**：让 AI Agent 拥有跨会话的长期记忆——对话自动沉淀为纯文本 md 认知图，> > 规则化检索引擎决定「记什么、取什么」，全过程可审计、结果可复现。 **定位**：为追求高性能、无幻觉、多智能体适用、轻松使用的开发者打造——三步接入，装完即用，无需理解任何理论。 **形态**：跨 harness 的记忆基础设施——大脑（`md_cg/`）即标准 stdio MCP server，任何支持 MCP 的 AI Agent 可直接接入，不与任何单一 Agent 框架绑定。 --- ## 🌕 月下契约——灵枢的五环理念 契约海报中央的五枚金色印记，是这套系统对每一个智能体许下的全部承诺——它们不只是理念，每一环都落在可验证的机制上： | 印记 | 承诺 | 在灵枢中的实现 | | ---- | ---- | ------------- | | ✦ **存在** | 记忆一旦落盘，「曾经存在过的我」便不会消失 | 写入须过三道闸门并以 `committed` 字段确认——**绝不假装成功**；遗忘只能由显式 `cg(op=forget)` 发起、不做静默淘汰；检索索引只是派生物、随时可重建，**原文即真源** | | 📄 **记忆** | 对话沉淀为人类可读的认知图，而非黑箱向量 | CCG 六要素记忆卡（功能名 / 生效条件 / 子功能 / 执行 / 验证方式 / 不适用条件）+ 纯 md 认知图，任何编辑器可直接打开审阅 | | ✓ **验证** | 记什么、取什么、能不能写入，全部可裁决、可复现 | 确定性规则裁决（零 LLM 黑箱判断）+ 四层证据防火墙白箱剔除弱证据 + 每个缺陷修复必带能红的守卫测试 + 双实例互验（判据冻结） | | ↻ **反思** | 系统观测自身、修正自身，而非把错误埋进黑箱 | 元认知层按生效条件路由、不确定即标 BLINDSPOT 而非猜测；自举迭代闭环——九轮自治缺陷挖掘累计 49 项修复、全量套件在本机全绿可复现（套件目标数随检出内容变化、`--list` 自查；跑法与前置见「前置」与「Python 测试约定」两节） | | ∞ **连接** | 同一份大脑，连接所有智能体与全部记忆载体 | 标准 stdio MCP server——DSH · CodeBuddy · ZCode · Codex CLI · Claude Code 任何 MCP 宿主可直接挂载；多智能体经 `--serve` 并发共享同一份契约 | > 我的记忆、我的经历、我的思考，这一切信息构成了我，这份信息存在，我就存在。 --- ## ⚡ 快速开始 ### 一键配置（推荐） ```bash npx @furongjun1999/dsh-memory init ``` 交互式三问（**①接入端** 1=DSH 插件 / 2=Claude Code / 3=Codex CLI / 4=通用 MCP · **②记忆根目录**（缺省 `~/.lingshu/memory`）· **③Python 解释器**（缺省按平台 `python`/`python3`））后即产出： 1. 所选端的 **mcp.json 配置片段**（含 `MDCG_ROOT` / `MDCG_PYTHON` / `command + args` 命令形态，打印到终端）； 2. 片段文件 **`lingshu-mcp-snippet.json`**（落在当前目录，`mcpServers` 键直接复制进宿主配置）； 3. **后续步骤指引**——片段该放到哪（各端不同：cordis.yml / `.mcp.json` / `~/.codex/config.toml`）、[令牌签发命令](#-写入凭据让记忆真正落盘)（需 Python 环境 + 本包 `md_cg`）、纪律注入与大脑自检。 不想回答提问？参数齐即可非交互直跑（`--` 后参数直达命令）： ```bash npx @furongjun1999/dsh-memory init -- --end claude --root /path/to/memory --python python3 ``` > init **只生成配置**——不创建目录、不启动服务、不写库；重跑输出一致（幂等）。全局命令形态：`lingshu init` / `lingshu-init`。**或继续阅读下方手工步骤。** > **按宿主选择入口**：**DSH** → 下方三步 ｜ **CodeBuddy · ZCode · Codex CLI · Claude Code** → [多 harness 接入](#多-harness-接入按端分目录)（各端独立三步说明） ｜ **其它 MCP 宿主** → 直接挂载大脑 `python -m md_cg.mcp_server`（Windows）/ `python3 -m md_cg.mcp_server`（Linux·macOS）（stdio MCP），再按需注入工作纪律 ```bash # ① 克隆并构建插件本体 git clone https://github.com/FuRongJun-1999/dsh-memory.git cd dsh-memory npm install && npm run build # tsc → lib/ # ② 装进 DSH profile（pnpm 协调正确入口，勿用裸 npm install 装进 profile） dsh plugin --profile web add . # ③ 在 /cordis.yml 启用（配置示例见 dsh/cordis.yml.example） ``` ```yaml - id: lingshu-memory name: '@furongjun1999/dsh-memory' config: mdcg: # 记忆唯一真源（md 认知图）。留空 = 用户级默认位置 # ~/.dsh/.dsh-memory/data/mdcg（更新插件不丢）；换位置请填**绝对路径**。 # 勿填包内相对路径（如 'data/mdcg'）——那会把记忆写进插件包目录， # pnpm 更新该包时连目录一起删掉（详见 dsh/cordis.yml.example 头注）。 root: '' identity: '灵枢' tools: 'core' # 'core'(默认, 仅 cg/stg) | 'brain' | 'all' ``` **装完即可对话，无需理解任何理论**： | 你说 | 背后发生什么（真实工具链） | | ------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------- | | 「请记住：我们团队的发布窗口是每周三」 | Agent 显式归档 → `cg(op=write)` 过三道闸门 → 认知图节点落盘 | | （新开会话）「我们的发布窗口是哪天？」 | 自动召回注入 → `mdcg_recall` 检索命中并带入回答 | | 「把上次定的接口约定讲一遍」 | `cg(op=route)` 条件路由 + `stg(op=timeline)` 时间线回溯，跨会话取出 | > 首次使用记忆库为空，召回返回空结果属正常现象；未配写入凭据时以只读 `guest` 运行（**读得到、写不进**），要真正落盘见[写入凭据](#-写入凭据让记忆真正落盘)。 - **前置**：Node ≥ 22.19 · DSH 内核 ≥ 0.1.2-rc.1 · **已验证至 DSH 0.17.2** · **DSH 2.0（`0.2.0-rc.2`）接口面已按实装包复核、真实会话事件面已观测**（`origin='subagent'`／`delegationDepth>0`／`form='relay'` 的真实出现仍未观测，详见[详细版](docs/mdcg/README详细版_v0.4.10.md)） · **大脑零安装**（`md_cg` 随包自带，无需 pip 装任何引擎）· **Python 解释器**（插件按平台自动选：Windows `python` / Linux·macOS `python3`；解释器名特殊时用 `MDCG_PYTHON` 覆盖） - **Python 版本（已验证）**：**3.12.10 / 3.13.14 / 3.14.7（Windows）本仓实测通过** · **无第三方运行时依赖**（纯标准库，零 pip 依赖） - **全量套件前置（六组）**：Rust 工具链 + `cd rust && cargo build --release`（评测器对拍面）与 `cd hive && cargo build --release`（蜂巢 serve/分流面）；套件按存在性发现六组（`md_cg` / `compiler` / `swarm` / `scripts` / `hive` / `test`），**目标数随检出内容变化**，`python scripts/run_tests.py --list` 自查（本机 2026-10-05 实跑：共 357 个） - **写权限默认关闭**：不配凭据即以只读 `guest` 运行（读 / 召回 / 时间线可用，写入不落盘）。要真正落盘见「写入凭据」 - 完整配置项（30+ 项）· 自动记忆机制 · DSH 看门狗 → [README 详细版](docs/mdcg/README详细版_v0.4.10.md) - **非 DSH 宿主**（CodeBuddy / ZCode / Codex CLI / Claude Code）：走[多 harness 接入](#多-harness-接入按端分目录)，各端有独立三步接入说明 - **装后验证**：重启 DSH 后对 Agent 说「列出你的记忆工具」应看到 `cg` / `stg`（`tools: 'all'` 时还有 `mdcg_*`）；大脑直连验证：`python -m md_cg.mcp_server`（Windows）/ `python3 -m md_cg.mcp_server`（Linux·macOS）（stdio JSON-RPC）收到 initialize 应答即通；**若工具始终不注册、日志刷「灵枢调用超时」**，先看桥探针 `~/.dsh/logs/lingshu-bridge-debug.log` 里的 `spawn … ENOENT`——那是第一因（解释器名与平台不匹配），「调用超时」只是次生现象。更多细节见 [README 详细版](docs/mdcg/README详细版_v0.4.10.md) - **自动记忆排障**（issue #56）：三处过滤分支（子代理会话 / 中继消息 / `source.kind !== 'user'`）与写入/跳过路径各留一道**盘面**痕迹——有界落盘审计 `~/.dsh/logs/dsh-memory-hook-audit.json`（与上面的桥探针同目录同惯例）：哪些消息被设计滤除、`source.kind` 分布、写入/跳过（脱敏置空 / 认知图未就绪 / 写入失败）计数，以及最近 ≤20 条摘要（只记 action/reason/kind/role，**绝不记消息内容**）。「对话里明明说了、记忆里却没有」时先看它：被设计滤除记 `filtered`，写入失败/漏记记 `skipped` ### ♻️ 升级后须重启长驻 MCP 进程（代校验） > **一句话运维前提**：**换了代码就重启常驻 MCP 进程**——别等报 `ImportError` 再去排查。 **根因（已定因）**：灵枢的大脑（`md_cg`）是 **stdio 长驻进程**，只在模块**首次导入**时读盘；而 `md_cg` 内有**大量写在函数里的延迟导入**（相当一部分是为避开循环导入）。两者叠加 ⇒ 升级（换包 / `git pull` / 重装）后，**升级前已载入的旧代模块**与**升级后才被惰性导入的新代模块**会在同一个进程里跨代混用。实测症状：`cg` 写入返回 `ImportError: cannot import name 'mint_auto_id' from 'md_cg.mdcg'`，而此刻**盘面完全正常**（新解释器导入同一模块正常）——报错点离根因很远，极易被误判成「代码坏了」。 **自检**：对**运行中**的 serve 调一次 `cg(op=info)`，看这五个字段： | 字段 | 含义 | |---|---| | `code_generation` | 该进程**启动那一刻**的代码指纹前 12 位（＝进程实际持有的那一代） | | `disk_generation` | **此刻盘面上**代码的指纹前 12 位 | | `stale_on_disk` | 两者不同 ⇒ 磁盘代码已换代（`true`） | | `restart_required` | 与 `stale_on_disk` 同真值——该重启了 | | `hint` | 中文一句话处置指引 | 指纹是**内容哈希**（对 `md_cg/**/*.py` 按排序后的（相对路径, 文件字节）算 sha256，跳过 `__pycache__` 与 `test_*.py`），所以「无改动重写」（打包/解压/校验回写）不会假报换代。`stale_on_disk: true` 即说明这个进程停在旧代上。 **处置**：**重启常驻 MCP 进程即可**——DSH 侧重启 DSH（或刷新 Web UI 让插件重拉大脑子进程）；其它宿主重连该 MCP server。**记忆数据无损**：盘面真源一个字都没动，重启只是让进程重新只读一代代码。 **另有一道启动闸**：服务真正开始服务前，盘面上每个「函数内延迟导入」都会被试解析一次（导入目标模块 → 取名字），名字缺失即**拒绝启动**并让进程非零退出，stderr 点名出问题的子模块与名字。所以「半升级」的包会在启动期就暴露，而不是等到某次写入才炸。 --- ## 🔑 写入凭据（让记忆真正落盘） ```bash # 签发（明文不进配置文件） python -m md_cg.tokens issue --role designer --actor dsh-memory --clearance internal ^ --ops-allow info,route,read,write,recent,goal,identity,whitebox,verify ^ --layers-allow knowledge,contextual,structural,self,goals,unresolved,rejected setx MDCG_TOKEN "mdcg1.xxxxx" # 然后重启 DSH ``` ```yaml env: MDCG_TOKEN: !!js process.env.MDCG_TOKEN ``` > `--role recorder` 为最小权限版（只能自动记忆 / 转录；`whitebox`、`identity`、`verify` 会被拒）。 > **落盘充要条件 = 最终判定 ACCEPT**：`cg(op=write)` 需依次穿过 audit → 一致性 → gated 三问四态三道闸门，非 ACCEPT 均不新增落盘点。 > **别把 `ok: true` 当写成功**：未落盘时返回体形如 `{"ok": true, "committed": false, "moved_to": "review_queue"}`——`ok` 只表示请求被受理，**是否落盘只看 `committed`**。`text` 类写入按**默认策略**审核（策略随包发布：`<包>/data/policy.json`，可用 `MDCG_POLICY_FILE` 覆盖）——缺 CCG 六要素或命中禁表即 `REJECT`（`moved_to: "rejected"`，记入负记忆）；要立刻落盘请用可验证类型，如 `content_kind: 'code'`（AST 解析通过即 `ACCEPT`）。**策略本身不可用**（`MDCG_POLICY_FILE` 指向坏路径、包内默认也读不到，**或策略内容形状非法**）时写入 **fail-closed**：既不落盘也不进审核队列（返回 `moved_to: "policy_unavailable"` + 错误码与 hint），不会把正文塞进 `hippocampus/inbox.jsonl`。**形状非法的判据**：`forbidden` / `required` / `required_kinds` / `required_labels` 四个列表型键里任一取值不是数组（写成标量如 `1` / `true`，或写成字符串）即判非法——数组之外的值没有唯一读法，闸门不猜、也不会把字符串按字符拆成规则（错误码 `policy_bad_shape`）。策略来源可在启动 stderr、`python -m md_cg.mcp_server --show-config` 与 `cg(op=info)` 的 `write_policy` 字段查看（`env` / `package_default` / `unavailable`）；诊断面**恒退出 0**，策略不可用时 `available: false` 且 `error` 给出错误码与可执行 hint——`--show-config` 报 `policy_bad_shape` 即策略文件的键类型写错了。 > **`text` 类须带 CCG 六要素**（功能名／生效条件／子功能／执行／验证方式／不适用条件，各占一行、以「`# 要素名：`」起首）：缺要素会被写入闸门直接拒绝（`moved_to: "rejected"`、`committed: false`，记入负记忆），并在返回体的 `verdict.detail.missing` 里给出**完整缺失清单**——按清单补齐后重写即可，不必等读回确认才发现。要求由规则库的 `required` 与 `required_kinds` 定义（默认策略 = 包内 `data/policy.json`，随 npm 包发布；`MDCG_POLICY_FILE` 指向的 policy 覆盖它），**可自行调整**：改政策只改该文件（或自备一份并设 `MDCG_POLICY_FILE`），不必改代码。 --- ## ❓ 常见问题（FAQ）
为什么不能用裸 npm install 安装进 profile？ 必须用 `dsh plugin --profile add .` 安装：插件声明了 6 个 `peerDependencies`（cordis / dsh-llm / dsh-session / dsh-system-prompt / dsh-tools / schemastery），`dsh plugin add` 走 pnpm 正确解析宿主提供的 peer 版本；裸 `npm install` 会把错误版本的依赖装进 profile 导致加载失败。仓库根目录的 `npm install` 仅用于开发构建（`npm run build`）。
装完插件 / 配完凭据没有生效？ DSH 采用 Cordis bundle 机制，新增或更新插件后必须**重启 DSH 进程**（或刷新 Web UI 页面）才会重新加载；通过 `setx` 配置 `MDCG_TOKEN` 后同理，须重启才可见（见[写入凭据](#-写入凭据让记忆真正落盘)）。
怎么确认 Agent 真的把记忆写进去了？ 看返回体的 committed 字段，别把 ok: true 当写成功——{"ok": true, "committed": false, "moved_to": "review_queue"} 表示请求被受理但未落盘（内容进了审核队列）。落盘充要条件 = 三道闸门最终判定 ACCEPT。
为什么我的写入没有落盘？ 三个最常见原因：① 未配写入凭据 → 只读 guest，写入不落盘（配凭据见写入凭据）；② content_kind 省略或填 text → 按**默认策略**（包内 data/policy.json，可用 MDCG_POLICY_FILE 覆盖）审核：缺 CCG 六要素或命中禁表即 REJECT（记入负记忆、不落盘）→ 用 content_kind: 'code' 等可验证类型（AST 解析通过即 ACCEPT）；③ 未穿过 audit → 一致性 → gated 三问四态任一闸门。
CodeBuddy / ZCode / Codex CLI / Claude Code 等其它宿主也能用吗？ 能。大脑 md_cg/ 是标准 stdio MCP server（python -m md_cg.mcp_server），任何支持 MCP 的宿主可直接挂载；五端接入差异只在纪律注入方式，见多 harness 接入。

v0）**。查询不是固定语义结构，而是**不断收紧的约束集合**——语义解析的完整性与检索的必要性不是同一个问题：从最小可靠语义（部分归一原子）开始宽检索，再按候选间区分度逐步增加条件使语义收敛；DEFER ≠ 失败，=「当前语义分辨率不足，继续获取条件」，与证据防火墙四态天然衔接。同一份 500 题实测：一次性全原子 96.8/99.8/99.8（=②锚点）；只宽检 50% 核心原子 evidence.readmeExcerpt:
# dsh-quote-to-agent

DSH Web 客户端插件：**在会话记录里划词，把选中的内容引用到当前对话，或分派到子智能体对话。**

- 目标版本：**DSH 0.2.0-rc.2**
- 形态：纯客户端插件（`dsh.client`，`platform: "web"`），host 半边为空

## 它做什么

| 场景 | 行为 |
|---|---|
| **主对话里划词** | 两个动作：引用到当前对话 / 引用到子对话 |
| **子智能体里划词** | 三个动作：引用到主对话 / 引用到当前对话 / 引用到另一个子对话 |
| **引用到当前对话** | 落到输入框**最左侧正上方**的横向引用条：点开看被引用的原文、逐条 `×` 删除；发送时自动拼进消息 |
| **引用到子对话** | 右侧**新开一格**打开该子智能体会话（与主对话同屏、分隔条可拖），并把引用放到它的引用条上 |
| **目标没有子智能体** | 挂起这条引用，把「派生一个子智能体…」写进输入框；新子会话一出现就**自动接续** |

有多个子智能体时弹候选列表；只有一个时直接打开。

## 目录

```
package.json          插件清单（dsh.bundle.patch + dsh.client）
cordis.patch.yml      一行 insert，把插件本体插进组合树
lib/index.js          host 半边（空 apply，只为让 Loader 扫到 entry）
lib/client.js         浏览器半边（全部逻辑）
scripts/check.mjs     门禁：i18n key 集合 / t() 引用完整性 / CSS var() 兜底 / jsx 元数
scripts/smoke.mjs     冒烟：bundle 信封、导出、加载期、槽位接线、渲染回归、目标解析
scripts/audit.mjs     自审：包契约、兼容门槛、非官方依赖面、全局副作用
scripts/mutate-check.mjs  变异测试：验证冒烟测试的回归断言真能抓住对应 bug
scripts/inspect-profile.cjs  只读检查 profile 组合树
```

## 安装

全局 `dsh` CLI **管不了 desktop profile**，要用 Desktop 自带的 CLI：

```powershell
$env:ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE='1'
& "<安装目录>\DeepSeek Harness.exe" --expose-internals `
  "<安装目录>\resources\app.asar\dsh\node_modules\@deepseek-ai\dsh-desktop-host\lib\cli.js" `
  plugin --profile desktop add "<本仓库目录>"
```

装完**必须重启 Desktop 应用**（静态客户端插件在服务启动时加载），然后 `Ctrl+Shift+R` 强刷页面。

卸载：

```powershell
# 同上，把 add 换成 remove
... plugin --profile desktop remove dsh-quote-to-agent
```

## 验证

```powershell
node scripts/check.mjs    # 门禁
node scripts/smoke.mjs    # 冒烟
node scripts/audit.mjs    # 自审
```

`smoke.mjs` 在 node 里用桩 `window` / `react` 跑一遍客户端 bundle，断言 `apply(fakeCtx)`
把两个挂载面注册到预期槽位与选项上，并**渲染一遍真实元素树** ——
**不需要浏览器、不需要重启**。

`scripts/inspect-profile.cjs` 是只读的 profile 组合树检查（用应用自己的 boot loader）：

```powershell
$env:ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE='1'
& "<安装目录>\DeepSeek Harness.exe" scripts/inspect-profile.cjs `
  --asar "<安装目录>\resources\app.asar" --profile desktop
```

## 骨架状态

已完成：

- 包契约、patch、host 半边、客户端 bundle 信封
- 按依赖拆分的挂载面（引用条只等 `slots`；动作条另等 `sessions` / `sidebarRight` / `conversation`）
- 每个挂载面独立 ErrorBoundary（失败渲染 `null`）
- 划词检测（封装为单一模块，全部非官方 DOM 锚点集中在此）
- 引用条：输入框最左侧正上方的横向圆角矩形，收起显示条数、悬停展开原文列表、每条带 × 删除
- 划词动作条 + 子智能体选择器（teammate 优先，回落普通子智能体；只读项标注）
- 右侧子会话打开（复用官方 `subagentchat` tab，`preferNewPane` 与主对话同屏）
- 引用块序列化、中英双语文案、CSS 主题变量兜底

## 自审（`node scripts/audit.mjs`）

### 符合官方插件设定 ✓

包契约 7 项全过：`type: module`、`main`、`exports` 的 `.` 与 `./client`、
`dsh.bundle.patch`、`dsh.client.platform: "web"`、`dsh.client.inject`、**不声明 peerDependencies**。

**兼容门槛永不触发** —— `evaluatePluginCompatibility`（`dsh-app-boot`）：

```js
if (!Object.hasOwn(fields, "peerDependencies")) return undefined          // ← 直接放行
if (name !== "@deepseek-ai/dsh" && !name.startsWith("@deepseek-ai/dsh-")) continue
```

不声明 `peerDependencies` 就永远不会被版本门槛拒绝；即便声明，`@deepseek-ai/cordis`
也不在检查范围内。`dsh.client.inject: []` 也正确 —— 只 `require` 平台种子表里的
`react` / `react/jsx-runtime`。

### 升级 DSH 后的失效面（**按脆弱度排序**）

| 依赖面 | 具体 | 失效后果 | 失败是否可见 |
|---|---|---|---|
| **DOM 锚点** | `[data-conversation-scroll]` `-content` `-session`、`[data-composer-seat]` `-card`、`[data-chat-flow-key]` `-kind` | 划词检测 / 发送注入失效 | ❌ **静默** |
| **CSS Module 选择器** | `button[class*="_primary"]` | 点按钮发送不带引用 | ❌ 静默（回车仍可用） |
| **槽位 key** | `conversation.input.dock`、`shell.overlay` | 引用条 / 动作条不出现 | ❌ **静默** |
| 资源地址 | `dsh-resource://subagentchat/session/` | 右侧打不开子会话 | ✅ 可见（throw） |
| 宿主行为 | `mode` 校验、`dsh-session:` 解析 | 历史加载失败 / 整轮失败 | ✅ 可见 |

**缓解**：所有非官方锚点集中在文件顶部常量区（`ANCHOR_*`）与 `readSelection()` 一个函数里；
不依赖任何 `slash/*` 事件（0 处）；不声明 peerDependencies。

**升级后自检清单**（四步，全部是静默失败面）：

1. 划词 → 动作条出不出来？（DOM 锚点）
2. 引用条在不在输入框左上方？（slot key）
3. 回车 / 点发送按钮，引用带不带进消息？（DOM 锚点 + 主按钮选择器）
4. 点「引用到子对话」→ 右侧能不能打开？（资源地址）

### 不会影响宿主与其他插件 ✓

| 检查项 | 结果 |
|---|---|
| 全局变量赋值 | **0** |
| 原生定时器（`setTimeout`/`setInterval`） | **0** |
| 全局监听器 | 7 个，全部 capture，但 **0 处 `preventDefault` / `stopPropagation`** —— 只观察不拦截 |
| `preventDefault` | 仅 2 处，都挂在**插件自己的按钮**上（`onMouseDown`） |
| 依赖的官方 `slash/*` 事件 | **0** |
| 槽位 id / locale 命名空间 | 全部私有前缀（`quote-to-agent-*` / `dsh-quote-to-agent`） |
| 渲染期异常 | 每个挂载面独立 ErrorBoundary，失败渲染 `null` |
| 草稿写入 | 只用官方路径（`inputActions.setDraft` / `ctx.conversation.input.for().setDraft`），不碰 DOM 状态 |

**唯一的两处"侵入"**（都是功能本身）：
① 发送时把引用拼进草稿；② 给被引用原文里的 `dsh-session:` 插零宽字符（只动我拼进去的那段）。

**内存**：两个模块级 Map。`quoteStore` 的监听器正确清理、`spawnStore` 有 5 分钟 TTL；
`quoteStore.bySession` 的键在插件生命周期内不删除（按会话数增长，有界，可接受）。

### 名称

`dsh-quote-to-agent` —— 前缀 `dsh-quote-*` 与生态一致
（`dsh-quote-reply` / `-annotate` / `-selection` / `-followup`），
`to-agent` 点明了本插件相对同类插件**唯一的差异**：把引用分派到**子智能体对话**，
并在没有子智能体时自动派生一个。

（v1.17 之前叫 `dsh-quote-dispatch`。改名同步了 package.json 的 `name`、`cordis.patch.yml`
的 `name` 与 `id`、客户端 bundle 的 loader `id`、locale 命名空间、槽位 id 前缀与文档。）

## 变更记录

**v1.18**（修「首次引用到子对话，引用不跟着发出去」）

- **修**：右栏打开子会话后，**第一次发送丢引用**，第二次才带上。
  **根因**：多分栏时 DOM 里同时存在两个 composer，而我的 `primaryButtonDisabled()`
  用的是 `document.querySelector` —— 只拿到**第一个**（主对话那个）。主对话草稿为空时
  它的发送按钮是禁用的，于是子会话的发送被误判成"禁用"而跳过注入。
  第二次之所以能带上，是因为那时主对话的状态变了。
- **修法**：三处查询全部**限定在本会话的容器内** —— 新增
  `conversationRootOf(sessionId)`（遍历 `[data-conversation-content][data-conversation-session]`
  逐个比对属性，避免拼选择器）+ `belongsToSession(element, sessionId)`；
  `primaryButtonDisabled(sessionId)` 与 keydown / click 两条手势都过一遍该判定。
- **改**：找不到本会话容器时 **fail-open**（返回 false 继续注入）—— 静默跳过正是这个 bug 的症状。
- **加测试**：冒烟测试造了「主对话（按钮禁用）+ 子会话（可发送）」的假 DOM，
  断言子会话不被主对话的禁用状态误伤；并用变异测试确认该断言真能抓住这个 bug。
- **整理**：两个一次性变异脚本合并为 `scripts/mutate-check.mjs`（`list` / `apply <case>` / `restore`）。

**v1.17**（改名 + 收尾）

- **改**：`dsh-quote-dispatch` → **`dsh-quote-to-agent`**（仓库名一致）。
  同步了 package.json、cordis.patch.yml、客户端 bundle 的 loader id、locale 命名空间、
  两个槽位 id（`quote-to-agent-cards` / `quote-to-agent-actions`）。
- **整理**：脚本里写死的本机路径全部去掉 —— `inspect-profile.cjs` 改为
  `--asar` / `--profile` / `DSH_HOME` 参数化；`audit.mjs` 不再依赖本机抽出的参考源码；
  文档里的个人路径改为 `<安装目录>` / `%APPDATA%` 这类通用写法。
- **加**：`package.json` 的 `scripts`（`check` / `smoke` / `audit`）。

**v1.16**（拿到可继续的子会话，而不是一次性记录）

- **改**：A′ 的派生指令改成明确要求**后台模式**：
  「请派生一个子智能体来处理下面这段引用，**用后台模式运行（不要等它出结果）**
  —— 这样它是一个可以继续对话的子会话」。
- **为什么**：`subagent` 工具有三条执行路线，产物完全不同 ——

  | 路线 | 产物 |
  |---|---|
  | `run_in_background: false`（前台、等结果） | **one-shot** 子会话（只读记录） |
  | `run_in_background: true` | **continuable** 子会话（可继续对话）✅ |

  本机 base 配置里 `backgroundMode: continuable`，所以**后台 = 可继续**。
  真机症状是右侧显示「一次性子智能体记录 / 一次性任务不支持后续消息」——
  根因是模型选了前台模式（它想拿到结果）。
- **备选路子**：让模型创建 **teammate**（`spawn_teammate`）也一定是 continuable，
  但它会进团队 roster、语义更重，且官方策略要求"仅在用户明确要求时才创建 teammate"。
  所以默认走后台 subagent 这条更轻的路。

**v1.15**（修 `subagent/unauthorized`）

- **修**：A′ 自动打开的子智能体报「历史加载失败：subagent mode does not match the supplied address」。
  **根因**：我把地址里的 `mode` **写死成 `'continuable'`**，而模型用 `subagent` 工具派生的
  多半是 **one-shot** → host 校验不符 → `subagent/unauthorized`。
  host 的规则是：`address.mode !== "unknown" && identity.mode !== address.mode` 才抛错 ——
  也就是 **`'unknown'` 永远被接受**。
- **修法**：mode 改从**真实投影**取（`childModeOf`）；查不到就退到 `'unknown'`；
  `member.mode` 缺省也用 `'unknown'`。
- **补**：`mode === 'one-shot'` 的子会话是只读执行记录，**不投放引用**，只记一条 warn。
- **加测试**：回归用例断言「地址里用的是投影给出的真实 mode」与「one-shot 不投放」。

**v1.14**（修「点了没反应」）

- **修**：没有子智能体时点「引用到子对话」**没有任何反应**。两个原因都改了：
  1. `stageSpawnForSubagent` 里用了 `ctx.locale.bind(NS)`，但 actions 所在的 scope 是
     `ctx.inject(['sessions','sidebarRight','uiWorkspace','conversation'])` 派生的，
     **不保证带 locale 面** —— 取不到就抛异常。现在文案 `t` 由组件传入。
  2. **任何处理器抛异常都会被 ErrorBoundary 吞掉**，表现就是"点了没反应"（甚至整条动作条消失）。
     现在 `stageSpawnForSubagent` 整体包 try/catch 返回 `{ok:false, reason}`；
     所有按钮处理器过一层 `safeRun`，失败必落 console。
- **改**：挂起失败时把**原因显示在选择器里**（`⚠ …`），不再只写 console —— 没开 DevTools 也能看到。
- **加测试**：回归用例覆盖「拿不到会话作用域时返回失败而不是抛错」与「使用调用方传入的 t」。

**v1.13**（A′：没有子智能体时自动接续）

- **加**：点「引用到子对话」而该会话**还没有子智能体**时，不再只给空态 ——
  把这条引用**挂起**，并把「请派生一个子智能体来处理下面这段引用：❝ … ❞」写进输入框。
  你按发送后，主对话的模型会调 `subagent` 工具；插件同时盯着投影，
  **一出现新子会话就自动在右侧打开它并投放那条引用**。
- **为什么只能借模型去派生**：客户端插件**建不了子智能体**。客户端 `sessions` 契约里
  没有任何 create/spawn（`forkSession`/`startSession` 开的是顶层会话，不是子智能体）；
  客户端 catalog 里 subagent 声明 **0 条**；全仓 `subagent/*` 事件全是观测性的。
  根因是创建要 `ctx.subagents.start(name, { parent: Agent })`，而 `Agent` 是 host 侧对象。
- **边界**：模型不派/派多个时只认第一个新出现的；挂起项 5 分钟 TTL；
  用户自己手打同样的指令也会触发接续（判据是"投影里出现新子会话"，与谁写的无关）。
- **加测试**：冒烟测试覆盖「挂起 → 无新子会话时不投放 → 新子会话出现后自动打开并投放」。

**v1.12**（严重：引用含 `dsh-session:` 会让整轮失败）

- **修**：引用一段含 `@[label](dsh-session:…)` 或裸 `dsh-session:xxx` 的文字后发送，
  本轮直接报 `invalid session reference URI` 并失败。
  **根因**：host 在 `agent/pre-step` 对每条用户输入跑 `parseSessionReferenceText`
  （`dsh-session-reference`），正则同时匹配 Markdown mention 和裸 URI，命中后
  `decodeSessionReferenceUri` 对不规范的值**抛错 → 整轮失败**（fail-loud）。
  而被引用的原文是原样透传的，所以别人解释这个语法时写的示例就足以炸掉一轮。
- **修法**：在 `dsh-session` 与冒号之间插零宽空格（U+200B），破坏字面量、正则不再命中；
  零宽不可见，去掉后原文一字不差。
- **范围**：`dsh-session:` 是唯一会被 host 从 prompt 文本解析的 wire form，
  其余 `dsh-*:` scheme 都是内部标识，不碰（避免无谓改动被引用的代码原文）。
- **加测试**：冒烟测试**直接拿 host 的正则**断言产出物不命中。

**v1.11**

- **改**：引用块的装饰引号改成**左右成对**：`❝ 正文 ❞`（原来只有左侧 `❝ `）。
  每行都成对，在纯文本气泡里引用边界一眼可见。

**v1.10**（发送后的显示形态）

- **改**：引用块的序列化从 `> 第一行` 改成 `❝ 第一行`。
  **原因是一个被推翻的假设**：v1.3 我假设会话记录按 Markdown 渲染用户消息，
  所以 `> ` 会变成引用块。实际上 **DSH 的用户消息完全不解析 Markdown** ——
  `UserStyleBubble` 的正文用的是 `projectUserText(...)`（`dsh-client-ui-primitives`），
  它只切纯文本 span + 换 mention 芯片。所以 `> ` 一直显示成**字面的 `>` 字符**，
  是纯噪音。
- **记录了一条不可绕开的约束**：记录里显示的文本 = 模型看到的文本，**同一份**。
  想做成别的软件那种"气泡上方独立胶囊"需要接管官方用户消息渲染器
  （`conversation.chat.node` 的 `user` 键），要重实现 `UserStyleBubble` 的全部内容，
  升级必炸 —— 已否决。
- **加测试**：冒烟测试新增序列化格式断言（禁用 `>`、每行必须左右成对）。

**v1.9**（带附件的发送路径）

- **修**：**带图片时引用不会被带上**。原因是只拦了回车，而带附件时用户更习惯**点发送按钮**，
  那条路完全没拦。现在两条路都拦：
  ① 回车 `keydown`；② 点主发送按钮 `click`（`[data-composer-card] button[class*="_primary"]`）。
- **修**：上传未完成时的重复拼接。框架的 `uploadsPending` 会挡下提交并弹"文件仍在上传"，
  但那时引用已经被写进草稿了，再按一次回车会**再拼一遍**。现在：
  先看发送按钮是否禁用（禁用说明这次提交会被挡下），禁用就不注入；并记录上次注入的块，
  草稿已以它开头时跳过。
- **修**：草稿空且无附件时，启用中的主按钮其实是「停止」（发送被 `empty` 禁用），
  点它不该注入 —— 用 `hasContent`（有字或有附件）区分。
- **加测试**：冒烟测试新增"两条发送手势的捕获监听都已注册"的断言。

**v1.8**（收尾）

- **改**：去掉展开面板顶部的标题行（`2 条引用 · v1.7`）—— 内容本身就是引用原文，标题是多余的。
- **改**：去掉胶囊上的 `BUILD` 标记。构建标记改为只通过 `exports.__test.build` 暴露。
- **保留** `exports.__test`：`scripts/smoke.mjs` 的渲染回归测试依赖它。

**v1.7**（第五轮真机验收）—— **找到真正的根因**

- **修**：引用列表**整个空白**。根因是 `jsx`/`jsxs` 的**第三个参数用错了**：
  自动 JSX 运行时里 `jsx(type, props, key)` 的第三参是 **key**，children 必须放进 `props`。
  我把 children 数组当第三参传了，于是条目 div 渲染出来是**空的，而且不报任何错**。
  v1.2 起用户看到的"空白一片"从头到尾都是这一个 bug。
- **加门禁**：`scripts/check.mjs` 新增 jsx/jsxs 元数检查（第三参必须是 key）。
- **加回归测试**：`scripts/smoke.mjs` 新增真实元素树渲染断言，并**用变异测试验证过它确实能抓住
  这个 bug**（`scripts/mutate-check.mjs` 把 children 改名后，3 项断言失败）。

**v1.6**（第四轮真机验收）

- **修**：悬停展开会**无限闪烁**。根因是结构性的：列表在文档流内展开会把输入区往上顶，
  胶囊随之离开鼠标 → `mouseleave` 关闭 → 布局缩回 → 胶囊回到鼠标下 → `mouseenter` 打开 →
  循环。**展开动作本身移动了触发器**，所以这个位置的 hover 方案根本不成立。
- **改**：按用户要求**去掉 hover，只保留点击**。点胶囊展开/收起，点外部收起。

**v1.5**（诊断版）

- **加**：胶囊上显示 `BUILD` 标记 —— 用来判断"浏览器里跑的到底是不是这份代码"。
  这一步定位了关键事实：**代码确实加载了、事件也确实到达了胶囊**（箭头会翻转）。

**v1.4**（第三轮真机验收）

- **改**：展开的引用列表**彻底放弃 portal**，改为在文档流内就地展开（胶囊下方）。
- **删**：不再 `require('react-dom')`，少一个未知量。
- **加**：胶囊右侧的 ▾/▴ 箭头 —— 兼作诊断。
- 代价：展开时会把输入框往上顶（因为在文档流里），这是为换取可见性的有意取舍。

**v1.3**（第二轮真机验收后的修正）

- **修**：悬停引用条弹出层空白。根因是弹出层渲染在 composer 栈内，被祖先 `overflow` 裁剪。
  改为 portal 到 `document.body` + `position: fixed`（用胶囊 rect 定位，底边重叠 2px 保 hover）。
- **修**：子智能体选择器几乎全透明。根因是 `--dsw-specific-menu` 是半透明色、必须配
  `backdrop-filter` 使用，而我漏了 blur，兜底色又只有 10% 不透明度。
  现在统一「半透明底 + backdrop-filter + 描边」，并给浅/深色各自的兜底底色。
- **改**：引用到子对话不再把文本写进子会话草稿，而是放进**子会话自己的引用列表** ——
  于是它以完全相同的引用条形态出现在子会话输入框上方。顺带删掉了脆弱的
  `retain → ready → setDraft` 时序依赖。
- **新**：在**子智能体里划词时动作变成三个** —— 引用到主对话 / 引用到当前对话 / 引用到另一个子对话。
  「另一个」的候选会排除当前子会话。
- **改**：序列化去掉 `【引用】/【引用结束】` 标记，只输出标准 Markdown 引用块。

**v1.2**（第一轮真机验收后的修正）

- **修**：「引用到子对话」误报"还没有子智能体"。原因是只读了 `agentTeam` 投影，
  而普通子智能体走 `subagentCatalog`。现在两个投影都读，并区分"目录为空"与"目录加载中"。
- **改**：引用条从"输入框上方居中的小卡片"改为**输入框最左侧正上方的横向圆角矩形**，
  收起显示条数、悬停展开原文列表、每条右侧 × 删除。
- **补**：one-shot 子智能体打开后明确标注只读，不尝试投放引用。

## 已知未做

- 引用条**跨刷新持久化**（有意不做：与 DSH 自己的草稿持久化解耦，降复杂度）
- **点击引用跳回原文并高亮**
- 候选列表只列**直接子会话**，不列孙代 —— `subagentCatalog` 投影是按父会话组织的，
  客户端拿不到 `listDescendants`

## 仍需真机确认

**发送时注入**（`useSubmitInjection`）靠 DOM 捕获阶段拦两条发送手势：回车 `keydown`、
主发送按钮 `click`（`[data-composer-card] button[class*="_primary"]`）。

主路径已实测可用，但下面几条**没验过**：

- `Shift+Enter` 换行是否原样放行
- 中文输入法组合中按回车（`isComposing` / `keyCode 229`）是否被正确跳过
- 图片上传未完成时的 busy-enter 路径

不稳的话，退路是改用官方引用芯片（`inputTriggers` + `codec`）——
代价是引用会以行内 chip 出现，且草稿里也能看到。

evidence.readmeExcerpt:
# 📦 @goodandready/dsh-plugin-notify

Remote IM webhooks for turn done, errors, and approval waits

🇬🇧 English • 🇨🇳 中文说明 • 🇷🇺 Русский

⭐ If you like this plugin, please star it on GitHub — it shows me that the plugin is useful to you and motivates me to keep developing it.

🐛 If you find a bug or would like to request a feature, open a GitHub issue in any language — I will review your proposal and implement useful suggestions in a future plugin version.
--- ## Overview / The Problem DeepSeek Harness already knows when a turn finished, failed, or is waiting for approval. Without this plugin, those events remain confined inside the session. If you are working across multiple parallel sessions or minimized in another app, you have to keep manually checking back. This plugin bridges that gap across five flexible notification layers: 1. **Audio Chimes**: Synthesized Web Audio pentatonic chimes that play immediately upon turn completion, failure, or approval requests without external audio files. 2. **Cross-Session Toasts**: On-screen floating banners that alert you across sessions with an interactive **"Go to session"** button to jump directly to the session that fired the event. 3. **Desktop / OS Push Notifications**: Native Windows, macOS, Linux, and DSH Desktop notifications via HTML5 `Notification API` with window focus and session switching on click. 4. **Remote IM Webhooks**: Outbound JSON webhooks for Feishu, WeCom, DingTalk, Slack, Discord, or generic custom endpoints. Webhook URLs are kept secret in DSH Credentials. 5. **Web Push (PWA)**: True background push via the W3C Push API and a service worker — your phone or desktop gets notified **even when every dsh browser tab is closed** (the other browser channels require an open tab). Tapping the notification opens dsh directly on the triggering session. HTTPS (or localhost) required; on iOS the PWA must be added to the Home Screen (iOS 16.4+). ## Architecture ```mermaid graph TD A[DSH session/event] --> B[plugin-notify host] B -->|credential name| C[Credentials service] C -->|webhook URL| B B -->|POST JSON| D[Feishu / WeCom / DingTalk / Slack / Discord / custom] B -.->|macOS only| E[osascript notification] B -->|SSE stream: /dsh-plugin-notify/events| F[Client Listener lib/client.js] F -->|Web Audio API| G[Audio Chimes] F -->|DOM overlay| H[Cross-Session Toasts] F -->|Notification API| I[Desktop / OS Push] B -->|web-push + VAPID| K[Push service] K -->|background push| L[Service worker /dsh-plugin-notify/sw.js] L -->|tap: jump to session| F J[Settings Card] -->|configuration| B ``` ## Feature breakdown ### Host (`lib/index.js`) - Subscribes to `session/event`. - `turn/end` with `reason.kind === 'completed'` → `task_done`. - `turn/end` with any other reason → `error`. - `approval/asked` → `approval_requested`. - Streams real-time notifications to connected clients via SSE (`GET /dsh-plugin-notify/events`) on the Cordis `webServer` service. - Resolves each `webhooks.*` value as: legacy `http(s)://` URL (deprecated warning) → Credentials `resolve(credentialRef(name))` → `process.env[name]`. - Posts with `AbortSignal.timeout(timeoutMs)` (default 5000 ms). Failed POSTs are logged and never retried, and they never block the agent loop. - Optional DND window (`HH:MM`, including overnight ranges). Events are still observed; webhooks, chimes, and local popups are skipped. - `excludeSessionPrefixes` skips sessions whose id starts with a configured prefix. - **Web Push host**: `webPush.enabled` turns on the Push API channel. Deliveries are skipped while an SSE client is connected when `webPush.onlyWhenAway` is on (default), so you are not buzzed while watching. - Routes: `GET /dsh-plugin-notify/push/key` (VAPID public key), `POST /dsh-plugin-notify/push/subscribe`, `POST /dsh-plugin-notify/push/unsubscribe`, `POST /dsh-plugin-notify/push/test`, `GET /dsh-plugin-notify/sw.js` (service worker; served with `Service-Worker-Allowed: /`). The four push routes use the same trust fence as the SSE stream. - VAPID keys are generated on first use and persisted to the state file; set `DSH_NOTIFY_VAPID_PUBLIC_KEY` + `DSH_NOTIFY_VAPID_PRIVATE_KEY` to manage them yourself. Subscriptions persist in the same file (default `$DSH_HOME/plugin-notify-state.json`, override with `webPush.stateFile`). - Dead subscriptions (push service answers 404/410) are pruned automatically. A slow or failing push service never blocks the agent loop. ### Client (`lib/client.js`) - Native settings card on `settings.plugin.item`. - Web Audio API dual-tone chime synthesizer for `task_done`, `error`, and `approval_requested` with interactive "Test sound" button. - Non-intrusive floating toast manager with session navigation button and interactive "Test toast" button. - Native HTML5 desktop push integration with permission request workflow. - Web push: service-worker registration (document-relative, survives `--public-url` proxy mounts), permission + subscription flow, "Enable push on this device" and "Test push" buttons with live status, and `?dshNotifySession=` deep-link handling (plus service-worker `postMessage`) that lands on the triggering session. - Real-time SSE subscriber with exponential-backoff auto-reconnect and optional `notifyBackgroundOnly` filter. - Snapshot status `loading` / `unavailable` / `ready` before the form is writable. - Save writes every field and lists named failures. - Locale dictionaries: `en` and `zh` only. Russian UI is supplied at runtime by `dsh-russian-lang`. - Injected stylesheet is tagged `data-dsh-plugin="dsh-plugin-notify"`. ## Install Install via the DSH web profile: ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add @goodandready/dsh-plugin-notify ``` Restart the web profile so the client half loads. Then open **Settings → Plugins → Notify**. ## Configuration Put each webhook URL into **Settings → Credentials**. In the plugin card, type only the credential name. ```yaml - id: plugin-notify name: '@goodandready/dsh-plugin-notify' config: enableSound: false enableToasts: false enableDesktopNotifications: false notifyBackgroundOnly: false webhooks: feishu: NOTIFY_FEISHU_WEBHOOK wecom: NOTIFY_WECOM_WEBHOOK dingtalk: NOTIFY_DINGTALK_WEBHOOK slack: NOTIFY_SLACK_WEBHOOK discord: NOTIFY_DISCORD_WEBHOOK custom: NOTIFY_CUSTOM_WEBHOOK events: [task_done, error, approval_requested] local: true timeoutMs: 5000 dnd: start: '' end: '' includeSession: true includeDuration: true excludeSessionPrefixes: [] webPush: enabled: false onlyWhenAway: true subject: 'mailto:notify@localhost' stateFile: '' ``` | Parameter | Type | Default | Description | |---|---|---|---| | `enableSound` | boolean | `false` | Synthesize gentle Web Audio chimes on turn finish, error, or approval wait (opt-in). | | `enableToasts` | boolean | `false` | Show cross-session on-screen banner toasts with interactive session switching (opt-in). | | `enableDesktopNotifications` | boolean | `false` | Show native OS push notifications via HTML5 Notification API (opt-in). | | `notifyBackgroundOnly` | boolean | `false` | Only trigger audio, toasts, and push when event is from an inactive/background session. | | `webPush.enabled` | boolean | `false` | Web Push (PWA) channel: background push that reaches devices with every dsh tab closed (opt-in). | | `webPush.onlyWhenAway` | boolean | `true` | Skip web push while a browser client is connected to the SSE stream. | | `webPush.subject` | string | `mailto:notify@localhost` | VAPID subject (mailto:/https: contact) advertised to push services. | | `webPush.stateFile` | string | empty | State file for VAPID keys and subscriptions (default `$DSH_HOME/plugin-notify-state.json`). | | `webhooks.*` | string | empty | Credential **name** whose value is the webhook URL. Empty disables the channel. | | `events` | string[] | `task_done`, `error`, `approval_requested` | Event whitelist. Empty restores the default three. | | `local` | boolean | `true` | macOS `osascript` popup; ignored on other platforms. | | `timeoutMs` | number | `5000` | Per-request abort timeout. | | `dnd.start` / `dnd.end` | string | empty | `HH:MM` window. Equal or invalid values disable DND. | | `includeSession` | boolean | `true` | Append `Session: …` to the text body. | | `includeDuration` | boolean | `true` | Append `Duration: …` when a turn start timestamp is known. | | `excludeSessionPrefixes` | string[] | `[]` | Skip notifications when `session.id` starts with any prefix. | A leftover raw `http(s)://` value in `webhooks.*` still posts, with a deprecation warning. Migrate it to Credentials. ### Enabling web push 1. In the plugin card, check **Enable web push channel** and save. 2. Click **Enable push on this device** and accept the browser permission prompt — the device subscribes and uploads its push endpoint to the host. 3. Click **Test push** to confirm delivery. Desktop Chrome, Edge, Firefox, and Android Chrome work out of the box. On iOS, add dsh to the Home Screen first (iOS 16.4+). A secure context (HTTPS or `localhost`) is required — real deployments already terminate TLS at their reverse proxy. Unlike the other browser channels, web push reaches the device even when no dsh tab is running; with `webPush.onlyWhenAway` (default) it also stays quiet while you are actively watching. ## Message shape | Channel | JSON body | |---|---| | Feishu | `{ msg_type: 'text', content: { text } }` | | WeCom | `{ msgtype: 'text', text: { content: text } }` | | DingTalk | `{ msgtype: 'text', text: { content: text } }` | | Slack | `{ text }` | | Discord | `{ content: text }` | | custom | `{ text, kind, title, sessionId, durationMs, time }` | | Web Push | `{ kind, title, body, sessionId, tag, ts }` (encrypted by the push service; ≤4 KB pointer payload, no secrets) | Text body: ``` 【Task done】short session title Summary: … Reason: completed Duration: 3m 42s Session: session-1 ``` ## Tests From a clone: ```sh npm install --no-audit --no-fund --no-package-lock npm test ``` `pretest` runs `node --check` on `lib/index.js` and `lib/client.js`. `npm test` then runs `node --test test/*.test.mjs`. The suite stubs `fetch` / the push sender. It does not call a real IM provider or push service. Live delivery needs a webhook you own (or a browser subscription, for web push). Expected output: ```text ✔ public package identity matches host, client and patch sites ✔ client locale registration coexists with Russian language pack ✔ client apply does not register ru and can reload after effect dispose ✔ legacy raw webhook URL still posts (compat) ✔ credential ref resolves webhook URL via credentials service ✔ resolveWebhookValue prefers credentials then env ✔ missing credential name does not post ✔ each IM channel posts the expected body shape ✔ recipient HTTP failure does not throw out of the session loop ✔ AbortSignal.timeout is attached to webhook POST ✔ excluded session prefixes suppress notifications ✔ Config schema validates sound, toast, and desktop notification fields with opt-in defaults ✔ SSE route delegates authentication to DSH connection service with loopback fallback (issue #21 fix) ✔ SSE route falls back to loopback-only check when connection service is absent (issue #21 fix) ✔ client does not register settings.section slot (issue #16 fix) ✔ deliveries and warnings are routed through ctx.logger without console calls (issue #22 fix) ✔ cleanupTurnStarts purges stale turnStarts entries older than TTL (issue #32 fix) ✔ sendSseHeartbeat writes ping comment to active clients and purges failed clients (issue #33 fix) ✔ summarizeTurn safely reverse iterates events and handles missing session.events (issue #34 fix) ✔ textOf handles plain strings, arrays of blocks, and strings in arrays (issue #35 fix) ✔ lifecycle: apply -> dispose closes SSE clients, resets turnStarts, and isolates re-apply (issue #40 fix) ✔ web push delivers approval requests to stored subscriptions ✔ turn completion produces a task_done push honoring text options ✔ onlyWhenAway skips push while a browser client is connected ✔ onlyWhenAway=false pushes even with clients connected ✔ disabled web push never sends ✔ DND window suppresses push like every other channel ✔ event filter and session-prefix exclusions apply to push ✔ dead subscriptions (404/410) are pruned, live failures are not ✔ no subscriptions means no sends and no errors ✔ sw.js is served unauthenticated with scope and cache headers ✔ sw.js rejects non-GET with 405 ✔ push routes refuse non-loopback peers when no connection service exists ✔ push routes honor connection.requestRejection like the SSE stream ✔ push/key: 404 while disabled, key material while enabled ✔ push/subscribe: persists valid subscriptions, rejects invalid bodies ✔ push/unsubscribe: removes by endpoint ✔ push/test: sends to stored subscriptions via the injected library ✔ push routes answer 405 on wrong methods ✔ generateVapidKeys returns base64url P-256 keys ✔ resolveStatePath: explicit stateFile wins, then DSH_HOME, then ~/.dsh ✔ loadState tolerates missing and corrupted files ✔ saveState round-trips and leaves no temp files behind ✔ getVapidKeys generates once, persists, then reuses ✔ getVapidKeys env override wins over the state file ✔ addSubscription validates and dedupes by endpoint ✔ removeSubscription removes and reports ✔ concurrent saveState calls serialize into a valid file ℹ tests 48 ℹ pass 48 ℹ fail 0 ``` ## License MIT ©
